description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.


This Position reports to:


Quality Manager **What we believe in**


At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration \- combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities \- are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions. That's our story. Make it your story.

**Your role and responsibilities**


In this role, you will have the opportunity to supervise a team of service engineers and technicians, ensuring timely and high\-quality delivery of service offerings, solutions, and projects to customers. Each day, you will contribute to the execution of service strategy and growth by focusing on cost\-effective service delivery and adherence guidelines. You will also demonstrate your skills by advancing service outcomes through resource planning, allocation, and the effective use of standard procedures and safety protocols.


The work model for the role is: \#Li\-Onsite


The role will support for the ABB India Ltd for Electrification Smart Building Business, Quality Function to be based at Nelamangala, BANGALORE, India.

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Service Management: Appoint and lead a designated Service Manager for WA, reporting to the Quality Manager, to oversee end\-to\-end service operations across India.
* Service Network Development: Establish and manage a nationwide service network by identifying service providers, appointing city/pin code\-wise service agencies, executing service agreements, and finalizing service costs and compliance requirements.
* Service Process \& Call Management: Develop standardized service procedures, manage the web\-based call center, monitor service requests, and oversee FOC approvals, service claims, and settlements.
* Customer Support \& Field Service: Ensure customer complaints are logged through the web portal, assign cases to the nearest service agency, facilitate on\-site product replacement, and ensure ticket closure based on customer confirmation or satisfaction code.
* Quality \& Continuous Improvement: Organize the collection and review of defective parts, track service performance, handle escalations, and support ongoing improvements in service quality and customer satisfaction.

**Qualifications for the role:**


* Qualification: BE/B.Tech. or Diploma in Electrical Engineering with 12–15 years of experience in post\-sales service within the Low Voltage (LV) Switchgear industry.
* Post\-Sales Service Management: Demonstrated solid skills in managing end\-to\-end post\-sales service operations and implementing effective service resolution strategies.
* Partner Network Management: Experience in developing, managing, and optimizing partner service networks to ensure seamless customer support.
* Technical Skills: Solid knowledge of LV switchgear products, including component selection, application, and customer complaint resolution.
* Communication \& Stakeholder Management: Well\-developed communication, customer relationship, and cross\-functional coordination skills.
* Leadership \& Team Management: Skilled in developing, coaching, and directing service teams to support smooth and effective operations.
* People Development: Emphasis on coaching, mentoring, and building team capabilities in line with organizational and HR policies.

**More about us**

  

ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications. The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meeting social and environmental demands, while being able to address even the most complex of customers’ carbon reduction strategies.

  

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.


Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.


Recruitment Fraud Warning


ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.


View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home


For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how\-to\-apply/fraud\-warning

description:
**About NCR Atleos**


NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self\-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.

**Company:** NCR Atleos

**Job Title:** Network Operations L2 Analyst

**Job Location:** Mumbai, India

**Shifts:** Rotational

 **Job Description:**


A Network Operations L2 Analyst plays a crucial role in maintaining and optimizing an organization's network infrastructure. Our company is growing rapidly and is searching for experienced candidates for the position of Network Operations L2 Analyst. While this is our ideal list, we will consider candidates that do not necessarily have all the qualifications but have sufficient experience and talent.

**Key** **Responsibilities**

* Implement and support of the corporate network infrastructure. Key member of the team responsible for designing and developing scalable and highly available global network architectures to meet the firm’s business needs.
* Participate in the design, setup and configuration of complex L2/L3 switches. Maintain, create and update all network documentation and topology diagrams.
* Support multiple datacenters consisting of Cisco Nexus LAN (L2/L3\), Console switches, ASA firewalls, Cisco UCS Fabric Interconnects, Palo Alto firewalls, Cisco Wireless LAN Controllers, Aruba Device and other miscellaneous network appliances.
* Research, evaluate, maintain and perform Cisco IOS code upgrades for a global network infrastructure.
* Leverage multiple network monitoring tools to analyze network traffic patterns to proactively identify performance issues and account for capacity planning.
* Work with multiple vendors routinely for support, feature enhancement and design strategy when required.
* Responsible for managing and maintaining SD Wan networks. Full ownership of all WAN routers, configurations, QoS policies and ensuring stability of the network 24/7\.
* Support manage and maintain all ISP Internet connectivity for the firm from multiple carriers with multiple links in multiple locations.
* Support, manage and maintain network monitoring system for the firm’s global network. This includes network performance monitoring for WAN/LAN links, network nodes, alerting and response, network configuration management and compliance and IP address management.
* Support of the firm’s global wireless infrastructure made up of all Cisco thin AP’s and Cisco Wireless LAN Controllers.
* On a rotating basis, provide after hour coverage to respond to network related issues occurring either before or after support hours.
* When requested, attends IT meetings and scheduled teleconferences.
* Other duties and projects as assigned.
* Opportunity to embrace the position, exposure to the latest technologies and growth potential.
 **Requirements**

* 3 \- 5\+ years related work experience preferably in a professional services environment.
* Experience with Cisco Nexus L2/L3 switching technology.
* Protocols EIGRP, BGP, OSPF, HSRP, IPSEC, VPN, NAT, 802\.1Q, 802\.11, LACP, Spanning\-tree, UDLD, BPDU, HTTP, HTTPS, DHCP, DNS.
* Experience with Cisco 4500, 3850, ASR/ISR routers and Nexus 7K/9K’s.
* Must possess a thorough understanding of Network Infrastructure and security topology. IP telephony a plus
* Knowledge and/or experience configuring and supporting Cisco ASA firewalls. VPN, IPS/IDS and Palo Alto.
* Experience with Cisco wireless technology and LAN controllers. Any prior experience Cisco ACS, Radius, TACACS, Prime or ISE.
* Network monitoring tools (SolarWinds, Site24x7\), SNMP, Wireshark.
* Experience with Zscaler and/or F5 load balancers very desirable, web URL filtering is a plus but not required.
* Excellent written, oral and interpersonal communications skills.
* Ability to conduct research into network issues and products as required.
* Ability to communicate ideas in both technical and user\-friendly language.
* Highly self\-motivated and directed, with keen attention to detail.
* Proven analytical and creative problem\-solving abilities.
* Able to prioritize and execute tasks in a high\-pressure environment.
* Strong customer service orientation.
* Experience working in a team\-oriented, collaborative environment.
 **Qualification**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in IT / Computer Science or equivalent streams.
* Cisco certifications in Routing, switching and/or Wireless is an added advantage.
 **Work Environment:**

* This is a full\-time position.
* Candidates must be ready to work 5 days a week from Mumbai office.
* Candidates should be ready to work in rotational schedules / shifts and supporting 24x7 operations.

Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job.

**EEO Statement**  

NCR Atleos is an equal\-opportunity employer.  In this role you will. .
   

  

 The Senior Network Engineer will work with other engineers to design, implement, monitor, and maintain the global enterprise network, with a focus on data center, office networking, and related services. You must possess a high level of technical expertise and be able to work with other technical teams, development teams, and support teams to support business objectives.
   

  

 Strong interpersonal skills are important. The ability to work effectively in a team environment composed of peers and cross\-functional members is critical as is the ability to be focused and a self\-starter.

 On our team, we. .

* Maintain technical documentation

description:
**Wi\-Fi \& RF design expert** 




  
 



 About the Company
 



  
 



 We are a leading internet service provider in India that was founded in 2007\. The company’s primary goal is to provide affordable and reliable internet connectivity to customers across India. We started by setting up a Campus Wi\-Fi network at Manipal University, Manipal, and later expanded its Wi\-Fi services to hospitality, co\-living, airports, malls, and other public spaces. The company owned and operated the largest campus Wi\-Fi network in the country and the Wi\-Fi network in some of the leading Indian hospitality chains, including Taj, Lalit, Lemon Tree, and Ginger.
 



  
 



 In 2011, we forayed into the residential broadband segment and became one of the first companies to adopt the highly reliable and high\-speed GPoN technology for delivering broadband services to its residential customers. We deliver speeds of up to 1 Gbps to its residential customers, and its unlimited data plans have been particularly popular among users who require highly reliable high\-speed bandwidth applications such as streaming video and online gaming. Currently, our services are available, both directly and indirectly through franchisees, in more than 3 lakhs residences across the country.
 



  





 Full\-time · permanent \| Engineering \& Product \| Bengaluru (WFO) \- 5 days a week
 



 Reports to: Head of Engineering \| Experience: 6–10 years 
 



  
 



 About the Role 
 



 Own end\-to\-end Wi\-Fi and RF design — from product specification and hardware selection through field deployment standards, NOC integration, and ongoing performance optimisation across a growing fleet targeting 100,000\+ APs. 
 



 You will be the technical authority on all 802\.11 matters — defining AP placement methodology, SSID/VLAN architecture, roaming behaviour, VoWiFi quality, RF interference management, and the Wi\-Fi\-specific sections of the product programme document. 
 



 This is a hands\-on engineering role with significant product influence. You will work across engineering, NOC, and product to translate RF design decisions into deployable configurations, monitoring thresholds, and automated remediation logic. 
 



  





 Key Responsibilities 
 



  





 RF \& Wireless Design 
 



 AP placement methodology — define AI\-assisted and manual survey\-based placement standards for villas, colliding \& coworking spaces. 
 



 RF interference management — identify and mitigate co\-channel and adjacent\-channel interference; define noise floor thresholds and corrective actions for NOC engineers. 
 



 Capacity planning — define client density limits per AP, MU\-MIMO/OFDMA utilisation targets, and load\-balancing triggers per deployment type. 
 



  





 Product and Configuration Design 
 



  





 SSID and VLAN architecture — own the Wi\-Fi specific sections of the PPD: 
 



 SSID design, VLAN mapping, WPA3 enforcement, 802\.11r/k/v roaming parameters, and sticky client remediation ladder. 
 



 VoWiFi quality design — define WMM/DSCP marking, U\-APSD config, roaming protection during active calls, IKE session stability requirements, and 
 



 SIP ALG mandates across CPE and ONT. 
 



 Hardware evaluation and selection — evaluate, test, and qualify AP hardware; define minimum spec requirements for future hardware additions; manage 
 



 BIS/WPC compliance verification. 
 



 Controller configuration standards — define controller configuration templates, 
 



 ZTP provisioning parameters, mobility domain IDs, and per\-site roaming boundaries. 
 



  





 NOC \& Monitoring Integration 
 



  





 Threshold definition — own all Wi\-Fi performance thresholds in the PPD: 
 



 RSSI targets, channel utilisation limits, roaming latency, MCS rate floors, sticky client event rates, and VoWiFi quality targets (jitter, MOS, IKE stability). 
 



 Alert and CFA design — define P1–P4 alert conditions for all Wi\-Fi metrics; write call\-for\-action playbooks for NOC engineers covering RF\-related faults including coverage gaps, interference, sticky clients, and VoWiFi degradation. 
 



 Wi\-Fi health score — own the health score formula (coverage, speed, uptime, 
 



 VoWiFi, roaming components); define weighting adjustments as fleet data matures. 
 



  
 



 Field \& Operational Standards 
 



  





 Installation SOPs — define RF\-specific installation standards for the remote first, app\-guided install model; cable routing, AP mounting height and orientation, backhaul port usage, and post\-install validation checklist. 
 



 Firmware governance — define the canary testing protocol for AP firmware updates; review release notes for RF\-impacting changes; own the 5%→fleet rollout schedule. 
 



 L2/L3 Wi\-Fi troubleshooting support — provide expert escalation support to the NOC for complex RF issues not resolvable via standard playbooks; 
 



 conduct remote RF analysis using controller data and Grafana metrics. 
 



 Skills and Experience Required: 
 



 802\.11 Protocols: Wi\-Fi 6 (802\.11ax), 802\.11r/k/v roaming, WPA3 / 802\.11W 
 



 PMF, OFDMA / MU\-MIMO \& Wi\-Fi 7 (802\.11be)   
 



 RF Design Tools: Ekahau / iBwave, Manual RF survey, Spectrum analysis, 
 



 AI placement tools, 3D floor plan modelling  
 



 Controllers and Platforms: Cambium cnMaestro/AirPro, Cisco Meraki / 
 



 Catalyst, Aruba Central, Ruckus SmartZone \& Ubiquiti UniFi      
 



 Networking Fundamentals: VLANs / 802\.1Q, WMM / DSCP / QoS, 
 



 IPv4/IPv6 dual stack, CAPWAP / controller arch \& WIDS/WIPS 
 



 VoWiFi \& Voice Quality: IKE / IPSec passthrough, SIP ALG impact analysis, 
 



 MOS / jitter / latency, U\-APSD / WMM AC\_VO \& IMS / ePDG architecture 
 



 Monitoring \& Analytics: Grafana dashboard design, Prometheus / SNMP metrics, RF log analysis, TimescaleDB queries \& PromQL basics      
 



 ISP / Access Network: GPON / EPON / ONT, TR\-069 / ACS basics, CPE dual\-WAN design \& TRAI QoS standards 
 



 Soft Skills: Technical documentation, Cross\-functional collaboration, NOC playbook writing, Vendor evaluation \& Field team training 
 



  





 Qualifications \- B.E./B. Tech in Electronics, Telecommunications, Computer Science, or related field \- CWNA (Certified Wireless Network Administrator) or equivalent \- CWDP / CWAP / CWSP \- Cambium Certified Wi\-Fi Professional or Cisco CCNP Wireless \- 6–10 years of hands\-on Wi\-Fi/RF design experience

description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.



You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.


### **Job Summary**



We are looking for a detail\-oriented, technically skilled Rack Lifecycle Tech to join our Rack Lifecycle Team within AWS Infrastructure Operations. In this individual contributor role, you will be a hands\-on executor responsible for the physical installation, cabling, handoff, and decommissioning of racks across your assigned data center site. You are the person on the floor who turns capacity plans into operational reality.



As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, you will execute structured cabling, rack installation, and decommission activities with precision and to standard — following established SOPs, escalating deviations to your team lead, and ensuring every rack you touch is installed correctly, cabled to specification, fully documented, and handed off with zero blockers. This is an individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities. Your work is foundational to AWS’s ability to deliver infrastructure capacity to customers reliably, safely, and at the lowest possible cost.



Key job responsibilities Rack Installation \& Cabling


* Execute rack installations including physical placement, power connections, grounding, and cable management per AWS standards and MOPs
* Perform structured cabling including fiber/copper terminations, patch panel connections, labeling, and dressing to specification
* Complete OTDR and power testing; validate results against acceptance thresholds; escalate failures to team lead promptly rather than self\-resolving outside approved procedures
* Follow all EHS protocols, lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures, and safe work practices during installation activities


 Rack Lifecycle Operations


* Execute work orders and tasks assigned by the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager under direct manager direction, maintaining accurate status updates in workflow management tools (e.g., Boost, MARS)
* Perform quality checks on completed cabling work including port map verification, label accuracy, and as\-built documentation updates in CMDB/DCIM
* Identify and escalate issues, blockers, or deviations from SOPs encountered during task execution to the team lead or manager promptly; do not self\-resolve outside approved procedures
* Support deployment wave readiness by participating in pre\-work site walks, material staging, and tool preparation


 Material Handling \& Supply Chain Support


* Receive, verify, and stage incoming rack, cable, optics, and hardware deliveries; validate against BOM and flag discrepancies
* Maintain accurate site inventory records for cables, optics, patch cords, and consumables used during deployments
* Support cycle count activities and assist in identifying inventory shortfalls that may impact deployment timelines


 Handover \& Documentation


* Complete all required as\-built documentation, port maps, test result records, and workflow sign\-offs before handoff to Data Center Operations
* Update CMDB/DCIM and IPAM records accurately following rack installation or decommission activities
* Ensure handoffs are clean and fully documented with zero open blockers, enabling smooth transition to the next lifecycle phase


 Rack Decommissioning


* Execute physical decommission activities per assigned MOPs — including cable removal, power disconnects, asset de\-tagging, and rack extraction
* Perform device wipe and media destruction in compliance with AWS Secure Media Destruction and EHS policies
* Sort, label, and stage recovered assets (optics, cables, PDUs, hardware) for RMA, redeployment, or secure disposal per AWS Reverse Logistics policy
* Update DCIM/CMDB, IPAM, and port maps post\-decom to ensure accurate space, power, and circuit records
* Validate that reclaimed U\-space, power, and cooling capacity is accurately recorded in the available pool


 Quality, Safety \& Compliance


* Adhere to all site\-level SOPs, quality standards, and governance frameworks for cabling, installation, and decommission activities
* Complete all required safety training and certifications; participate in regular EHS audits and team safety briefings
* Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying recurring quality issues, suggesting process improvements, and sharing feedback with the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager
* Use Rack Lifecycle Team tooling (e.g., Boost, MARS, ALM/DCLM) accurately to record work, track assets, and maintain data integrity


 Cross\-Team Coordination


* Support coordination with DCO, DCEO, Network Engineering, and facilities teams during active deployment or decom activities under manager guidance to ensure smooth execution
* Participate in daily stand\-ups and pre\-work briefings; communicate clearly on task status, blockers, and schedule adherence
* Provide accurate, timely updates on task completion and flag risks or delays to the team lead immediately


 Continuous Learning \& Development


* Maintain and develop technical proficiency in structured cabling, fiber optics, rack installation, and data center physical infrastructure
* Complete required certifications and training modules including EHS, LOTO, and any Rack Lifecycle Team\-specific technical programs
* Proactively seek feedback from leads and managers to improve personal performance and output quality
* Support the onboarding and training of new team members; share knowledge and best practices with peers to build overall team capability and quality standards
* Stay current on AWS infrastructure tooling, cabling standards, and process updates communicated by the Rack Lifecycle Team


A day in the life As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, your day is on the data center floor. You might start the morning by reviewing your assigned work orders in Boost, checking in with your team lead on priorities, and staging cables and optics for a rack installation wave. By midday, you could be terminating fiber runs at a patch panel, running OTDR tests to validate loss results against acceptance thresholds, or labeling and dressing a freshly installed rack. In the afternoon, you might be updating CMDB records for completed work orders, de\-tagging and staging recovered assets from an EOL decom, or helping onboard a new technician by walking them through the SOP. If you encounter a deviation from the approved MOP, you escalate it to your team lead immediately — you don't improvise. Your role is hands\-on, technical, and precise — you execute the work that keeps AWS capacity on track.

description:
### **Job Description**


**Job Description for Engineer – Product (VAVE \& Sustaining)**


### **Job Description**



Coordinate with design, production, procurement, and product testing teams to validate cost\-optimized solutions for existing and new products under VAVE (Value Analysis and Value Engineering) initiatives. The primary responsibility is to ensure reliability, functional integrity, and certification compliance after implementing VAVE changes. This role requires validating design and component modifications through structured testing, automation programs, and compliance assessments. The candidate must ensure that all VAVE changes maintain product performance, safety, and quality standards without compromising customer requirements. Being part of a Global Engineering Function, the role demands strict adherence to defined processes and communication protocols.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Perform testing and validation of VAVE\-related design and component changes in power supply products, modules, and systems.
* Conduct hardware and software testing (black box/white box) for communication power products to ensure compliance post\-cost optimization.
* Develop and maintain automated test programs for validating VAVE modifications efficiently.
* Formulate test plans, stress conditions, and procedures for evaluating new components or design changes introduced through VAVE.
* Collaborate with design, procurement, reliability, and compliance teams to verify cost\-optimized solutions without affecting performance.
* Ensure all VAVE changes comply with UL, CE, and other international safety and certification standards.
* Prepare detailed test reports, risk analysis, and recommendations for each VAVE implementation.
* Participate in root cause analysis for failures during VAVE validation and provide corrective action inputs.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance cost competitiveness while maintaining high reliability and safety standards.


**Job Specifications:**


* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Power Electronics / Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
* **Experience:** 3 to 4 years of experience in power electronics product/module testing (AC/DC chargers, DC/DC converters, UPS preferred).
* Hands\-on experience in automation testing tools and programming for test systems.
* Strong understanding of analog and digital circuits, power conversion principles, and common topologies.
* Knowledge of safety certification processes (UL, CE) preferred.

The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between a FortiGate policy, a Juniper SRX zone, a Cisco routing table and a wireless controller in the same day, and will be able to explain to a customer what changed and why. 
 Key responsibilities 
 Wireless Configure, operate and troubleshoot enterprise WLAN controllers, access points, SSID-to-VLAN mapping, and AP provisioning. Implement secure wireless authentication using WPA2/WPA3-Enterprise with 802.1X and RADIUS, and support certificate and guest access methods. Carry out RF planning and validation, site surveys, channel and power planning, coverage and interference checks. Diagnose client-side problems: association and authentication failures, roaming, sticky clients, band steering and throughput complaints. 
 Firewall and security Build and maintain firewall policies, NAT rules and object groups on Fortinet FortiGate, Juniper SRX and Cisco ASA or Firepower. Configure and support IPSec site-to-site and SSL/remote-access VPN, including troubleshooting phase 1 and phase 2 negotiation. Operate security profiles application control, web filtering, IPS and antivirus and tune them to reduce false positives. Support firewall high availability pairs, firmware upgrades and rule-base reviews and clean-ups. 
 Routing and switching Configure and troubleshoot routing on Cisco IOS/IOS-XE and Juniper Junos static routing, OSPF and basic BGP. Support the switched estate: VLANs, trunking, spanning tree, link aggregation and port channels. Work with WAN and internet links, including failover, routing policy and ISP coordination. 
 Operations and delivery : Respond to incidents within agreed service levels, perform root cause analysis and close the loop with the customer. Raise and execute changes through the change process, including rollback plans and post-change validation. Monitor the estate using SNMP, syslog and NMS tooling; investigate using packet captures where needed. Produce and maintain configuration documents, as-built records, network diagrams and standard operating procedures. Take part in the on-call rota and attend customer sites in and around Bangalore when hands-on work is required. 
 Essential skills and experience 
 Experience : 3 to 4 years in enterprise networking, with genuine hands-on configuration and troubleshooting rather than monitoring only. 
 Wireless : Working experience with at least one enterprise WLAN platform Cisco (WLC / Catalyst 9800), Aruba, Ruckus or equivalent covering controller and AP configuration, 802.1X and RF troubleshooting. 
 Firewalls : Hands-on with at least two of Fortinet FortiGate, Juniper SRX and Cisco ASA / Firepower. Comfortable working at CLI, not only through the GUI. 
 Routing: Practical routing and switching on Cisco IOS/IOS-XE or Juniper Junos: static routing, OSPF, VLANs, trunking, spanning tree and link aggregation. 
 VPN : Configuration and troubleshooting of IPSec and SSL VPN. 
 Troubleshooting: Structured fault isolation, log analysis and packet capture using Wireshark or an equivalent tool. 
 Documentation : Able to write clear configuration records, change plans and diagrams that a colleague can follow. 
 Communication: Able to explain a technical issue to a non-technical customer contact, in English and ideally in Hindi or Kannada. 
 Desirable : 
 Certification in one or more of: CCNA or CCNP Enterprise / Security, Fortinet NSE 4 or above, JNCIA or JNCIS. Exposure to SD-WAN, particularly FortiGate SD-WAN or Cisco Viptela. Experience with network access control, RADIUS or Cisco ISE. Familiarity with data centre switching, and with structured cabling and rack work. Scripting for routine tasks Python, Ansible or similar. Experience working to ITIL-style incident, change and problem processes. 
 Qualifications : 
 Bachelors degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline. Candidates with a diploma and strong demonstrable hands-on experience will also be considered.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams, vendors, and stakeholders to implement infrastructure enhancements and resolve critical issues. Strong expertise in Routing & Switching technologies including BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VRFs, and WAN environments. Proven experience configuring and managing Palo Alto, FortiGate, and Cisco ASA/FTD firewalls. Deep knowledge of network security concepts, VPN technologies, IPS/IDS, and access control mechanisms. Experience implementing and supporting Windows NPS, RADIUS, 802.1X authentication, and PKI infrastructure. Strong working knowledge of Aruba Wireless technologies including Aruba Controllers, Aruba Central, and Access Points. Experience with cloud networking services in AWS, Azure, and GCP environments. Expertise in network troubleshooting, packet analysis, root cause analysis, and performance optimization. Familiarity with SD-WAN, MPLS, hybrid cloud connectivity, and enterprise network architecture. Strong understanding of security compliance frameworks, governance standards, and risk management practices. Experience working with ITIL-based service management processes and incident management frameworks. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, documentation, and collaboration skills. * Networking, including LAN/WAN

You will independently own and resolve the most difficult technical problems, mentor junior support engineers, and partner closely with Engineering and Product on defect resolution and long\-term fixes. A positive attitude, strong customer service instincts, and expert\-level troubleshooting skills are required. You will be looked to as the technical authority on our product and on the customer environments it supports — networks, virtualisation, and cloud infrastructure alike.**
  

  

  





**Job Requirements**



* Bachelor's degree in an IT\-related field or equivalent work experience
* 7–12 years of direct customer support, network engineering, or systems administration experience, with significant time spent in a senior/escalation\-tier (L3\) capacity
* Deep, hands\-on knowledge of datacenter operations, including physical and virtual infrastructure
* Expert\-level networking knowledge is required — this is a core, non\-negotiable requirement for the role
* Strong working knowledge of SNMP, VMware, and Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI)
* Working knowledge of AWS cloud services and how cloud infrastructure is discovered and represented in a CMDB



**Main Responsibilities**



* Take ownership of the customer issues escalated from L1/L2, seeing problems through to full resolution
* Research, diagnose, troubleshoot, and identify solutions for system and network issues
* Perform in\-depth analysis of customer network architecture (routing, VLANs, firewalls, ACLs, NAT) to isolate root causes of discovery and connectivity failures
* Follow standard procedures for escalating unresolved issues to the appropriate internal teams, while acting as the escalation point for those below you
* Respond to partner and customer inquiries through email and telephone, including complex technical discussions with customer network/infrastructure teams

* Comfortable acting as the technical authority in customer\-facing network architecture discussions

* Participate in an on\-call support rotation, which could include weekends and holidays
* Author troubleshooting guides and knowledge base content, and mentor L1/L2 engineers on networking, SNMP, virtualisation, and cloud fundamentals
* Willing to work in rotational shifts, including the US time zone.
* Proven ability to diagnose complex, multi\-layered technical issues spanning network, systems, and application layers
* Strong analytical and root\-cause analysis skills
* Experience with ticketing systems and SLA\-driven, escalation\-tier support environments



**Technical Skills:**



* Expert\-level, hands\-on knowledge of TCP/IP networking, subnetting, routing protocols (OSPF, BGP), VLANs, and switching/routing architecture
* Deep, demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex network architectures across LAN/WAN, data center, multi\-site, and hybrid cloud environments
* Strong command of firewall rules, ACLs, NAT, and segmentation, and how they impact device discovery and connectivity
* Lead network engineering and systems administration troubleshooting for customer environments, including SNMP polling, discovery configuration, and credential/access issues
* Support customer VMware and VDI environment discovery, including hosts, clusters, VMs, and datastores
* Support discovery and inventory of AWS cloud resources (EC2, VPC, networking constructs) within customer environments

* Advanced ability to troubleshoot SNMP community strings, authentication/encryption (SNMPv3\), credential issues, and polling failures at scale
* Experience with Windows and Linux server configuration, including remote access protocols (WMI, SSH, WinRM)
* Hands\-on experience with VMware vSphere/vCenter environments, including hosts, clusters, VMs, and datastores
* Familiarity with Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) platforms (e.g., Citrix, VMware Horizon) and how they integrate with discovery/CMDB tools


* Working knowledge of core AWS services relevant to infrastructure discovery: EC2, VPC, Subnets, Security Groups, IAM, and Route 53
* Understanding of how cloud\-native networking constructs (VPC peering, NAT gateways, load balancers) affect discovery and asset mapping
* Familiarity with AWS CLI/console for troubleshooting connectivity and permission issues impacting discovery jobs


* Experience with Device42 or similar CMDB/ITAM discovery tools (e.g., ServiceNow Discovery, Freshservice, BMC Helix Discovery) strongly preferred


**Qualifications**
* 7–12 years of direct customer support, network engineering, or systems administration experience, with significant time spent in a senior/escalation\-tier (L3\) capacity
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to varied audiences
* Strong customer\-first mindset with a focus on timely resolution and clear communication
* Ability to work independently while collaborating cross\-functionally with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success teams

We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
**Role:** 
 Senior Network Engineer – VoIP / Real\-Time Communications
 



**Function:** 
 Network Engineering / VoIP Infrastructure
 



**Location:** 
 Gurugram or Kolkata
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 AI, Medical SaaS, Dental Medical SaaS
 



  





**About Company** 




 The company builds AI\-powered SaaS for the U.S. dental market.
 



 Its all\-in\-one platform unifies analytics, scheduling, communications, payments, and marketing automation. Thousands of dental practices across North America rely on it daily.
 



 It was founded in 2015 by a practicing dentist, a data strategist, and a PhD technologist. The team of \~88 moves fast, ships real value, and works with high ownership and tight cross\-functional collaboration.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 This role owns the network connectivity and real\-time communications infrastructure that enables the company's VoIP platform to reliably communicate with customer networks, SIP carriers, and the public internet. The engineer will be responsible for troubleshooting end\-to\-end VoIP connectivity and media issues across the entire network path — from customer phones and LAN infrastructure through switches, routers, firewalls, VLANs, Wi\-Fi, VPNs, and ISP connections, to the company's SIP infrastructure and upstream carriers. This is a hands\-on production troubleshooting role requiring strong networking fundamentals combined with a deep understanding of SIP, RTP, NAT traversal, and real\-time communications. The engineer will work closely with the company's SIP/VoIP engineering team, customer IT teams, carriers, and support/operations teams to diagnose and resolve complex voice\-quality, connectivity, registration, signaling, and media\-path issues.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Own end\-to\-end network troubleshooting for the company's VoIP traffic between customer environments, the company's SIP infrastructure, and upstream carriers/PSTN networks.
* Diagnose SIP signaling and RTP media issues across customer LANs, firewalls, routers, switches, Wi\-Fi networks, VPNs, ISP connections, and internet paths.
* Analyze SIP messages, SDP, RTP flows, packet captures, and network telemetry to identify the root cause of call failures and audio\-quality issues.
* Troubleshoot common VoIP networking problems including NAT traversal, SIP ALG, asymmetric routing, blocked ports, firewall policies, RTP path failures, DNS issues, packet loss, jitter, latency, and network instability.
* Work directly with customer IT/network teams to identify problems within their network and provide clear, technically accurate remediation guidance.
* Guide customers through configuration and troubleshooting of switches, routers, firewalls, VLANs, DHCP, Wi\-Fi, VPNs, ISP connectivity, QoS, and related network infrastructure required for reliable VoIP service.
* Validate network readiness for the company's VoIP deployments, including connectivity, port accessibility, NAT behavior, SIP signaling, RTP media paths, and network quality.
* Troubleshoot SIP registration, call setup, one\-way/no\-way audio, dropped calls, delayed audio, call quality degradation, intermittent connectivity, and other real\-time communications issues.
* Investigate SIP/RTP traffic between customer endpoints and the company's infrastructure and determine whether failures originate in the customer network, internet path, the company's infrastructure, or the carrier network.
* Work with the SIP engineering team to distinguish network\-layer problems from SIP application, routing, registrar, proxy, B2BUA, or media\-server issues.
* Troubleshoot and validate SIP connectivity over UDP, TCP, and TLS, as well as media secured using SRTP.
* Work with RTP proxies and understand their role in resolving NAT and media\-path challenges.
* Troubleshoot real\-time communications involving STUN/TURN and WebRTC networking where applicable.
* Implement and troubleshoot network QoS, DSCP marking, traffic prioritization, and other mechanisms required for reliable voice communications.
* Investigate voice\-quality metrics including latency, jitter, packet loss, MOS, and RTP stream behavior.
* Use tools such as tcpdump, Wireshark, SIP trace, and other networking utilities for packet\-level troubleshooting.
* Troubleshoot connectivity and routing between the company's SIP infrastructure and upstream SIP carriers/PSTN providers.
* Assist with network architecture and configuration changes required to support SIP servers, RTP/media infrastructure, carrier connectivity, and high\-availability VoIP services.
* Define and maintain network monitoring, alerting, diagnostics, and operational tooling for VoIP connectivity and network health.
* Participate in production incident response, escalation, root\-cause analysis, and post\-incident reviews.
* Develop troubleshooting procedures, network diagnostic tools, runbooks, and documentation that reduce recurring VoIP incidents and improve MTTR.
* Perform capacity and performance analysis of network paths supporting real\-time communications and proactively identify potential bottlenecks.
* Collaborate closely with SIP engineers to ensure that network architecture, SIP routing, media handling, and customer connectivity work reliably together.



  





**Must Have Criteria** 



* 7–10 years of network engineering experience with at least 4–5 years working with VoIP, SIP, or real\-time communications networks.
* Strong understanding of enterprise networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, UDP, routing, switching, VLANs, DHCP, DNS, NAT, firewalls, VPNs, and QoS.
* Deep practical understanding of VoIP networking and the behavior of SIP and RTP across real\-world networks.
* Strong understanding of SIP signaling, SDP, RTP, SIP registration, call setup, media negotiation, and common SIP failure scenarios.
* Hands\-on experience troubleshooting SIP/RTP traffic using packet captures and tools such as Wireshark and tcpdump.
* Strong understanding of NAT traversal, symmetric RTP, SIP ALG, port mapping, firewall behavior, and asymmetric routing.
* Experience troubleshooting voice traffic across customer LANs, switches, routers, firewalls, Wi\-Fi networks, VPNs, and ISP connections.
* Ability to analyze an end\-to\-end VoIP packet flow and determine where signaling or media is being blocked, modified, delayed, or lost.
* Strong Linux networking fundamentals and experience troubleshooting network connectivity from Linux systems.
* Experience working with SIP over UDP, TCP, and TLS, and media using RTP/SRTP.
* Understanding of RTP proxies and their use in real\-world SIP architectures.
* Understanding of STUN/TURN and NAT traversal techniques used by real\-time communications systems.
* Familiarity with WebRTC networking and SIP over WebSockets.
* Strong understanding of VoIP quality metrics including latency, jitter, packet loss, MOS, and RTP behavior.
* Experience with QoS, DSCP, traffic prioritization, and network optimization for voice traffic.
* Experience troubleshooting connectivity to SIP carriers, PSTN gateways, interconnects, and external VoIP providers.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to work from packet captures, SIP traces, logs, and network telemetry rather than relying only on application\-level symptoms.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work directly with customer IT/network teams to explain technical issues and guide them through network changes.
* Comfortable working on production incidents and participating in on\-call/escalation responsibilities.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience working with Kamailio, OpenSIPS, FreeSWITCH, Asterisk, SBCs, or similar VoIP infrastructure.
* Experience troubleshooting RTP proxy deployments and complex NAT/media\-path scenarios.
* Experience with SIP trunking and carrier interconnects.
* Experience with WebRTC, SIP over WebSockets, STUN/TURN, and browser\-based real\-time communications.
* Experience with network monitoring and observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or similar tools.
* Experience building automated network diagnostics or VoIP troubleshooting tools.
* Familiarity with BGP, OSPF, advanced routing, or carrier\-grade network architectures.
* Experience troubleshooting enterprise firewall platforms and network equipment from vendors such as Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Juniper, Ubiquiti, or similar.
* Experience with network automation and infrastructure\-as\-code.
* Experience supporting geographically distributed VoIP or CPaaS platforms.
* Experience working with call centers, unified communications, SIP trunking, or large\-scale telecommunications environments.



  





**What We Offer** 



* End\-to\-end ownership of a critical, high\-visibility infrastructure layer used by thousands of dental practices daily.
* Close collaboration with a focused SIP/VoIP engineering team working on an AI\-first communications platform.
* Autonomy, flexible scheduling, and direct impact on measurable outcomes — call quality, uptime, and MTTR.
* Opportunity to build in a large, under\-digitized healthcare vertical at a company with strong product\-market fit and a clear growth trajectory.

title: Senior Network engineer(Storage L3)
description:
**Job Description**

**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI\-led, platform\-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry\-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654\.4M FY26 revenue with 17\.4% Y\-o\-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436\.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3\.2% Q\-o\-Q and 16\.2% Y\-o\-Y growth. Our 27,500\+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix*®* Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix*®* Assessment 2026\.

 **About Position:**

  

The Senior Network engineer ensures proper management of the Network services (including LAN, SDWAN, MAN, Voice, Video, Wireless, ISP, Zero Trust, EDMZ, and Contact Center Technologies) for in conjunction with the vendor(s). In addition, this role supports Network availability and the introduction of new technology into the Network environment.

* **Role: Storage L3**
* **Location: Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad**
* **Experience: 12\-18 years**
* **Job Type: Full\-Time Employment**

 **What You'll Do:**

  

* Act as the ultimate point of contact for intricate storage problems, providing expert guidance and resolutions.
* Create robust storage designs tailored to large\-scale enterprise needs, considering factors like scalability, performance, and redundancy.
* Establish and enforce effective storage management practices, ensuring data protection, availability, and compliance.
* Estimate future storage requirements, analyze performance metrics, and optimize resource utilization in extensive storage environments.
* Plan and implement strategies to ensure data continuity during disasters or disruptions, including failover and data replication.
* Assess storage security risks, apply necessary controls, and safeguard data integrity and confidentiality.
* Advise on compliance standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) related to storage systems, ensuring adherence to legal and industry regulations.
* Work with other IT teams to seamlessly integrate storage solutions into broader infrastructure, such as databases, applications, and virtualization platforms.
+ Help create and maintain documentation, policies, and standards related to storage management, ensuring consistency and alignment with organizational goals.

* Stay informed about emerging storage technologies, evaluate their suitability, and drive their adoption within the organization.
* Oversee data backup and recovery processes using Tape libraries, ensuring reliable backups and efficient restoration.
* Set up and maintain data replication solutions for disaster recovery purposes, ensuring data availability and minimizing downtime.
* Stay current with storage industry trends, attend conferences, and explore new technologies to enhance storage practices.
* Diagnose and address storage\-related problems, including data corruption, loss, and system failures, ensuring minimal impact on operations.
* Apply security controls, enforce access restrictions, and protect data stored in storage systems from unauthorized access or breaches.
* Actively engage in disaster recovery drills to validate the effectiveness of recovery procedures and enhance preparedness for real\-world incidents.

 **Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* NetApp Certified Technology Solutions Professional, Pure Storage FlashArray Storage Professional, VMCE, IBM Storage, TSM backup
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, or a related discipline.
* Approximately five years of experience in a company’s storage environment.
* Familiarity with disaster recovery technologies and data replication.
* Hardware and Software Expertise: Proficiency in both hardware and software aspects of storage systems.
* Awareness of the latest trends in data storage, backup strategies.
* Disaster Recovery Planning: Contribute to disaster recovery planning to prevent data loss during system failures or cyber\-attacks.
* Minimum of 7 years' experience of contributing to the success of a range of midsize\-to\-large initiatives with above\-average levels of complexity and business criticality, building a team\-oriented, collaborative environment, and creating business cases and managing budgets,
* Experience managing public internet routing, transport and access
* Extensive knowledge of network service providers for both Public and private line access
* Experience in facilitating change, including collaboration with management stakeholders.
* Proven internal and external influencing skills at senior and executive management levels.
* Preferably proven experience or demonstrated capability in leading large, complex and or transformational initiatives in dynamic environments and taking advantage of digital opportunities to innovate business models and enable the digitalization of the business.

 **Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company\-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check\-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

 **Values\-Driven, People\-Centric \& Inclusive Work Environment:**

  

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility\-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

 **Let’s unleash your full potential at Persistent \-** **persistent.com/careers**

 ***“Persistent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind.”***

description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**

  

At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.

  

Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

**Job Title: Network Engineer Security I (2nd Shift)**

**Job Overview:**


LPL is seeking a Senior Network Security Engineer for their network security products, including Palo Alto, Fortinet, and Cisco Next\-Generation firewalls. This individual will be part of a team of technical engineers, overseeing implementation, and operations management of network security products operating in a multiple data center environment offices, and the cloud. The position directly relates to securing and protecting LPL, our Advisors, and their clients.

**Responsibilities:**

* Implement and Tier 2 support solutions focused on Palo Alto and Cisco FTD, Fortinet firewalls
* Tier 2 support of operations of VPN and Cisco ISE/NAC remote access environment
* Implementing firewall solutions in the AWS cloud environment using an auto\-scaling design
* Troubleshooting complex network security issues, identifying the root cause of issues and developing continuous improvement of the platform
* Security hardening of platform devices reduces vulnerability footprint
* Managing firewall service requests (MACD)
* Manage and optimize logging of firewall traffic and rule\-based activity
* Maintain security baseline standards, design documentation, and diagrams
* Automation development using scripting languages such as Python or PERL and leveraging APIs for data exchange

**Requirements:**

* 3\+ years of engineering and administering an enterprise\-level Palo Alto and/or Fortinet environment
* 2\+ years of Networking experience and knowledge of network devices (routers, switches, etc.), including such topics as HTTP headers, ISO layers, and TCP flags.
* Ability to generate and read packet captures for troubleshooting of data traffic flow.
* Fundamental knowledge of encryption, including HTTPS decryption and re\-encryption, to examine data traffic content.

**Core Competencies:**

* Excellent troubleshooting skills and ability to identify root causes of issues and provide solutions.
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills, both oral and written, with the ability to articulate and educate others about complex technology with business acumen.
* Accurate diagramming and documentation skills.

**Preferences:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field.
* Palo Alto Professional Security Certifications desirable such as PCNSE.
* Security and Network Certifications such as CISSP, CEH, CCNP, CCNA, CCIE are desirable.
* Enterprise level Network Routing protocols such as OSPF and BGP configuration.
* Familiarity with industry standard automation tools

title: Network Engineer
description:
Network Engineer**About Millennium**  

Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989\. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium’s mission is to deliver results for our investors.


Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact.

**Meet the Team**  

Core to the health and growth of our business, Millennium’s active, multi\-manager model depends on flexible, scalable technology and advanced proprietary systems, including the development of next\-generation analytical and trading capabilities. This role sits within the Asia Infrastructure team and the Follow The Sun network engineering function, a global team responsible for engineering, automating, monitoring, and supporting high\-performance networks with demanding uptime requirements. The team partners across infrastructure disciplines including Data Center Management, Windows, Unix, Cloud, Information Security, and virtualization, while supporting colleagues across the US, EMEA, and APAC.

**What You'll Do**  

* Engineer, operate, and implement enterprise network solutions across market data, low\-latency execution, data center, backbone, desktop connectivity, corporate Wi\-Fi, and remote office environments
* Support high\-performance networks with stringent uptime requirements using modern network technologies and disciplined operational practices
* Act as an escalation point for critical network issues and help drive timely resolution of complex production challenges
* Partner with global engineering teams to address key network priorities and advocate for the needs of the APAC region
* Implement global network standards and contribute to automation frameworks that improve deployment and operational efficiency
* Provide L2/L3 operational support across a broad enterprise networking environment
* Mentor junior engineers and help strengthen team capability through knowledge sharing and hands\-on support
* Identify opportunities to improve, streamline, and automate network operations processes
**What You Bring**  

* At least 3 years of hands\-on experience in a technical network engineering role
* Strong technical ownership and the ability to operate effectively within a global organization
* Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate across engineering teams and infrastructure disciplines
* A strong operational mindset, with a commitment to mentoring junior engineers and improving team processes
* Deep knowledge of BGP, with working knowledge of OSPF and IS\-IS
* Strong experience in trading network implementation and operations, including provisioning connectivity to exchanges and counterparty B2B connections
* Understanding of low\-latency technologies and how latency can affect trading strategies
* Knowledge of multicast\-based market data delivery; experience with data center networking, WAN engineering, network security, cloud networking, automation, or performance monitoring tools is a plus

**Key Responsibilities:**
 Cloud Network Engineering

* Design highly available, resilient, scalable, and secure network architectures.
* Support cloud landing zones and cloud foundation initiatives.


 Enterprise \& Corporate Networking
   

  

* Design, implement, manage, monitor, and troubleshoot enterprise LAN/WAN infrastructure.
* Manage and troubleshoot VLANs, Routing, Switching, Wireless Networks, VPNs, Firewalls, Proxies, and Network Access Controls.
* Establish secure connectivity between corporate offices, remote locations, data centers, and cloud environments.
* Monitor network availability, utilization, capacity, and performance trends.
* Drive lifecycle management, upgrades, migrations, and technology refresh projects.


 Server Infrastructure Management
   

  

* Design and manage connectivity supporting Linux, Windows, physical, virtual, and cloud\-hosted servers.
* Troubleshoot DNS, routing, firewall, certificate, server communication, storage, and application connectivity issues.
* Support provisioning, decommissioning, migration, and modernization efforts.
* Ensure secure segmentation between applications, servers, storage, and cloud environments.


 Hybrid \& Multi\-Cloud Connectivity
   

  

* Manage AWS Direct Connect, AWS Site\-to\-Site VPN, AWS Transit Gateway, GCP Cloud Interconnect, GCP Cloud VPN, OCI FastConnect, and OCI VPN.
* Design and manage secure connectivity across on\-premises, cloud, remote, and data center environments.
* Troubleshoot end\-to\-end connectivity issues across hybrid and multi\-cloud ecosystems.
* Design resilient architectures eliminating single points of failure.


 Network Architecture \& Design
   

  

* Develop architecture diagrams, design documentation, reference architectures, and operational standards.
* Design scalable IP address management, subnetting, routing, and DNS strategies.
* Establish standards for traffic flow, network segmentation, connectivity, and security.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend strategic improvements.


 Network Security
   

  

* Design and manage Security Groups, Network ACLs, Cloud Firewalls, WAFs, Firewall Policies, Network Segmentation, and Private Endpoints.
* Support TLS/SSL, Certificates, Encryption, Secure Communication, and Zero Trust initiatives.
* Monitor and investigate suspicious network activities and security events.
* Partner with Security teams to remediate vulnerabilities and strengthen compliance posture.


 Infrastructure as Code \& Automation
   

  

* Develop and maintain network infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code practices.
* Build reusable Terraform modules and standardized deployment frameworks.
* Automate provisioning, configuration validation, compliance checks, testing, and operational processes.
* Develop automation using Python, Bash, and PowerShell.
* Support CI/CD\-driven infrastructure deployment and change management.


 Network Monitoring \& Observability
   

  

* Monitor latency, throughput, packet loss, DNS performance, load balancer health, VPN health, connectivity, and utilization.
* Leverage Datadog, CloudWatch, Flow Logs, telemetry, and observability platforms.
* Create operational dashboards, alerts, and proactive monitoring frameworks.
* Analyze telemetry and logs to improve reliability and performance.


 Production Support \& Incident Management
   

  

* Provide L3 support for critical network, server, cloud, and connectivity incidents.
* Troubleshoot routing failures, DNS outages, VPN issues, firewall problems, application connectivity issues, and cloud networking incidents.
* Perform root cause analysis and drive permanent corrective actions.
* Participate in on\-call support, disaster recovery exercises, and business continuity activities.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
* 8\+ years of enterprise network engineering experience including cloud networking.
* Strong AWS networking expertise with exposure to GCP and OCI.
* Hands\-on experience with LAN/WAN, hybrid cloud, server, and data center infrastructure.
* Strong Terraform, Python, Bash, and PowerShell automation capabilities.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, documentation, and problem\-solving skills.


 Strong Understanding Of
   

  

* TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Routing, BGP, OSPF, VPN, NAT.
* Firewalls, Proxies, Load Balancing, TLS/SSL, and Network Segmentation.
* Cloud Networking Services and Enterprise Connectivity.
* Hybrid Cloud Architecture and Network Security Principles.


 Technical Skills Matrix
   

  

* Cloud Platforms: AWS, GCP, OCI
* Networking: VPC, VCN, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, FastConnect, DNS, Routing, Switching, VPN
* Security: Palo Alto, Cisco, F5, WAF, ACLs, Security Groups, TLS/SSL
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform
* Automation: Python, Bash, PowerShell
* Monitoring: Datadog, CloudWatch, Flow Logs, Telemetry
* Operating Systems: Linux, Windows Server


**Preferred Qualifications**
* AWS, OCI, GCP, Cisco, or Palo Alto certifications.
* Experience working in large\-scale enterprise and multi\-cloud environments.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation programs.
* Experience collaborating with SRE, Systems Engineering, Security, and Cloud Engineering teams.


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* Highly reliable and secure network connectivity across all environments.
* Reduced operational effort through automation and infrastructure standardization.
* Improved network observability, stability, performance, and security.
* Reusable network architecture patterns and Terraform modules adopted across teams.
* Recognized technical leadership and mentorship within engineering organizations.

title: Network Engineer II
description:
**About NCR Atleos**
 NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self\-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.
   

  

**Company:** 
 NCR Atleos
   

  

**Job Title:** 
 Network Operations L2 Analyst
   

  

**Job Location:** 
 Mumbai, India
   

  

**Shifts:** 
 Rotational
   

  

**Job Description**
 A Network Operations L2 Analyst plays a crucial role in maintaining and optimizing an organization's network infrastructure. Our company is growing rapidly and is searching for experienced candidates for the position of Network Operations L2 Analyst. While this is our ideal list, we will consider candidates that do not necessarily have all the qualifications but have sufficient experience and talent.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Implement and support of the corporate network infrastructure. Key member of the team responsible for designing and developing scalable and highly available global network architectures to meet the firm’s business needs.
* Participate in the design, setup and configuration of complex L2/L3 switches. Maintain, create and update all network documentation and topology diagrams.
* Support multiple datacenters consisting of Cisco Nexus LAN (L2/L3\), Console switches, ASA firewalls, Cisco UCS Fabric Interconnects, Palo Alto firewalls, Cisco Wireless LAN Controllers, Aruba Device and other miscellaneous network appliances.
* Research, evaluate, maintain and perform Cisco IOS code upgrades for a global network infrastructure.
* Leverage multiple network monitoring tools to analyze network traffic patterns to proactively identify performance issues and account for capacity planning.
* Work with multiple vendors routinely for support, feature enhancement and design strategy when required.
* Responsible for managing and maintaining SD Wan networks. Full ownership of all WAN routers, configurations, QoS policies and ensuring stability of the network 24/7\.
* Support manage and maintain all ISP Internet connectivity for the firm from multiple carriers with multiple links in multiple locations.
* Support, manage and maintain network monitoring system for the firm’s global network. This includes network performance monitoring for WAN/LAN links, network nodes, alerting and response, network configuration management and compliance and IP address management.
* Support of the firm’s global wireless infrastructure made up of all Cisco thin AP’s and Cisco Wireless LAN Controllers.
* On a rotating basis, provide after hour coverage to respond to network related issues occurring either before or after support hours.
* When requested, attends IT meetings and scheduled teleconferences.
* Other duties and projects as assigned.
* Opportunity to embrace the position, exposure to the latest technologies and growth potential.


**Requirements**
* 3 \- 5\+ years related work experience preferably in a professional services environment.
* Experience with Cisco Nexus L2/L3 switching technology.
* Protocols EIGRP, BGP, OSPF, HSRP, IPSEC, VPN, NAT, 802\.1Q, 802\.11, LACP, Spanning\-tree, UDLD, BPDU, HTTP, HTTPS, DHCP, DNS.
* Experience with Cisco 4500, 3850, ASR/ISR routers and Nexus 7K/9K’s.
* Must possess a thorough understanding of Network Infrastructure and security topology. IP telephony a plus
* Knowledge and/or experience configuring and supporting Cisco ASA firewalls. VPN, IPS/IDS and Palo Alto.
* Experience with Cisco wireless technology and LAN controllers. Any prior experience Cisco ACS, Radius, TACACS, Prime or ISE.
* Network monitoring tools (SolarWinds, Site24x7\), SNMP, Wireshark.
* Experience with Zscaler and/or F5 load balancers very desirable, web URL filtering is a plus but not required.
* Excellent written, oral and interpersonal communications skills.
* Ability to conduct research into network issues and products as required.
* Ability to communicate ideas in both technical and user\-friendly language.
* Highly self\-motivated and directed, with keen attention to detail.
* Proven analytical and creative problem\-solving abilities.
* Able to prioritize and execute tasks in a high\-pressure environment.
* Strong customer service orientation.
* Experience working in a team\-oriented, collaborative environment.

In this role, the Network Operations Engineer will remediate critical alerts within defined SLAs, triage production impacting network incidents, and interact with internal customers on network related issues. **Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Strong background of Mellanox/Cumulus OS.

* Maintain rigorous data lineage, assumptions registers, and version control for geological models and estimation inputs.

**Geological Interpretation and 3D Modelling**  

* Lead the interpretation of orebody geometry, lithology, stratigraphy, weathering, alteration, mineralisation, and structural controls using drilling, mapping, geophysical, and other datasets.
* Develop, update, and review three\-dimensional geological, domain, and mineralisation models for open\-pit and underground deposits.
* Produce and review geological sections, plans, wireframes, surfaces, solids, and supporting visualisations for technical review and client communication.
* Work with geotechnical, hydrogeological, mine planning, and engineering disciplines to ensure geological interpretations support wider project objectives.
**Mineral Resource Estimation**  

* Lead exploratory data analysis, domaining, compositing, top\-cut assessment, declustering, variography, density assignment, and selection of estimation parameters.
* Build, review, and validate block models using appropriate estimation techniques, and support Competent or Qualified Persons in resource sign\-off.
* Undertake model validation using visual, statistical, and spatial comparison methods, and clearly document results and limitations.
* Lead mineral resource classification, reporting, reconciliation, risk, and sensitivity assessments in line with applicable project and reporting requirements.

**Technical Reporting and Compliance**  

* Author and review technical reports, memoranda, presentations, model documentation, data\-room reviews, and due\-diligence deliverables.
* Deliver work aligned with recognised mineral resource reporting frameworks, including JORC, NI 43\-101, and S\-K 1300, as applicable to the assignment.
* Prepare clear descriptions of data, methods, assumptions, limitations, risks, and recommendations for internal, client, and public\-reporting audiences.
* Ensure calculations, figures, tables, and model outputs are technically consistent, traceable, and suitable for independent review or audit.
* Apply and uphold WSP quality\-management, checking, review, document\-control, health, safety, and environmental requirements.
**Exploration and Field Support**  

* Plan, review, and provide technical oversight of exploration, drilling, logging, sampling, QA/QC, density, mapping, and field data\-collection programmes.
* Undertake or supervise geological core logging, field mapping, sampling oversight, and contractor coordination during site assignments.
* Assess the adequacy and spatial distribution of geological information and recommend additional data collection where required.
* Comply with project and site health, safety, environmental, and operational requirements during all field activities.
**Project Delivery, Leadership, and Collaboration**  

* Deliver assigned resource geology scopes across WSP's global mining business as part of the GCC Specialist Mining Services team.
* Work closely with the Mining Team Leader on resourcing, planning, scheduling, budgets, quality expectations, and delivery of project commitments.
* Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and review for junior and intermediate geologists, and support their technical development.
* Engage directly with WSP global mining leaders, project managers, and clients to clarify requirements, present findings, and provide expert recommendations.
* Participate in the full project lifecycle, including proposals, scopes of work, contract inputs, technical quality, and senior review.
* Communicate progress, data limitations, technical risks, and required decisions promptly and clearly across regions and time zones.
* Support business development through technical input into proposals, client meetings, and presentations.
* Contribute to standard methods, templates, reusable workflows, lessons learned, knowledge sharing, and capability building within the team.

  
**Education and Experience**  

* Master's degree in Geology, Applied Geology, Engineering Geology, Mining Geology, Earth Sciences, or a related discipline. A Bachelor's degree with strong relevant experience will also be considered.
* Approximately 6 to 10 years of relevant experience in resource geology, exploration geology, or mining consulting, covering open\-pit and/or underground projects.
* Demonstrated experience delivering geological models and mineral resource estimates as part of studies, operations, or independent reviews.

**Technical Skills**  

* Strong capability in geological interpretation, three\-dimensional wireframing, domaining, block modelling, and resource model validation.
* Sound understanding of sampling theory, QA/QC, descriptive statistics, geostatistics, variography, and common estimation methods.
* Working knowledge of mineral resource reporting frameworks, including JORC, NI 43\-101, and S\-K 1300\.
* Proficiency in relevant geological and mining software such as Leapfrog Geo / Edge, Datamine, Surpac, Vulcan, Micromine, Maptek, Deswik, AutoCAD, ArcGIS, or QGIS.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and confidence working with large, complex technical datasets.
* Ability to prepare and review clear figures, plans, sections, tables, model documentation, and technical reports in English.
* Understanding of quality assurance, technical checking, data governance, and version control for geological deliverables.

**Mining and Consulting Knowledge**  

* Solid understanding of open\-pit and underground mining workflows and how geological models inform mine planning, evaluation, and investment decisions.
* Ability to identify geological uncertainties and clearly communicate their implications for resource confidence and project outcomes.
* Awareness of multidisciplinary interfaces with geotechnical engineering, hydrogeology, metallurgy, mine planning, environment, and closure.
* Proven ability to deliver technically appropriate, cost\-effective solutions within scope, schedule, budget, quality, and safety requirements.
* Proficiency in spoken and written English; proficiency in French is considered an advantage, although not mandatory.

**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Experience leading mineral resource estimates for open\-pit or underground hard\-rock mining projects.
* Exposure to multiple commodities, deposit styles, and stages of study or operation.
* Experience with database systems, scripting, workflow automation, Python, R, SQL, or data visualisation tools.
* Experience contributing to technical studies, due diligence, audits, independent reviews, or public\-reporting documentation.
* Field experience in geological mapping, drilling supervision, core logging, sampling, or exploration

**programme management.*** Familiarity with reconciliation, grade control, short\-term modelling, or operational geology workflows.
* Experience working within distributed, multidisciplinary, or global project teams.
* Professional registration, or eligibility for registration, with a recognised professional geoscience body, with progress toward Competent or Qualified Person status considered an advantage.

**Key Competencies**  

Geological judgement Develops and defends sound interpretations from available evidence and clearly communicates uncertainty and limitations.
  

Technical leadership Takes ownership of assigned scopes, guides junior staff, and provides constructive technical review.
  

Technical accuracy Applies rigorous checking, consistent methods, and strong attention to detail across datasets, models, and reports.
  

Problem solving Investigates data and modelling issues systematically and develops practical, defensible solutions.
  

Client focus Understands client and project needs and delivers responsive, value\-adding technical advice.
  

Communication Presents technical findings clearly through concise writing, effective graphics, and confident discussion.
