title: Senior Consultant - Power Systems
description:
The **Energy Advisory** service line is composed of the **Power Systems Consulting** and **Energy Strategy.**

**Consulting** teams delivering services to clients, typically in the utilities sector. We are seeking a Power Systems Consultant to be part of our Power Systems Consulting team in the United Kingdom while working remotely from India. The position will include delivering a range of projects within the Power Systems team and supporting with bidding and winning work. As part of the role, you will be involved in writing technical reports and business proposals as well as engaging directly with clients, therefore, excellent verbal and written communication skills in English are essential for the role. An ability and enthusiasm to learn new technical skills is essential. The work is fast paced and, as a result, excellent organisational skills are also required. * Steady studies such as load flow, fault level and reactive compensation

* Harmonic analysis/ power quality/ filter design;

* Control interaction studies;
* Earthing studies;

* To provide technical and project management leadership to support the project team in the successful delivery of consulting work;

title: Investment Data Product Development Lead, Vice President
description:
**Who we are looking for**

State Street Investment Management's Data, Analytics \& AI Services (DAAIS) organization is seeking a Vice President, Investment Data Product Development Lead to lead the development of enterprise investment data capabilities supporting analytics, risk, reporting, operations, and investment decision\-making.


This role combines deep expertise in institutional investment management data with strong data management and leadership capabilities. The successful candidate will provide domain leadership across key investment data areas while managing a team of data engineers responsible for delivering scalable, trusted, and reusable data solutions. Working closely with engineering leadership, architecture teams, and business stakeholders, the candidate will ensure that complex investment data requirements are translated into robust technical solutions that support both current and future business needs.


This role is ideal for a leader who has extensive experience with investment management data and enjoys partnering with engineering teams to design, build, and operationalize enterprise data capabilities. A seasoned investment management data expert who understands Security, Holdings, Benchmark, Performance, Risk, and Portfolio data in depth, can lead a team of engineers, and can translate institutional knowledge into scalable engineering solutions.


**Why this role is important to us**

The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Investment Management, one of the largest asset managers in the world. We partner with many of the world’s largest, most sophisticated investors and financial intermediaries to help them reach their goals through a rigorous, research\-driven investment process. With over four decades of experience and trillions of dollars in assets under management, we offer one of the broadest selections of services across asset classes, risk profiles, regions and styles. As pioneers in index, ETF, and ESG investing, we are always inventing new ways to invest.


Join us if making your mark in the asset management industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.


**What you will be responsible for**

As Investment Data Product Development Lead, Vice President you will \-


**Investment Data Domain Leadership**

* Serve as a subject matter expert across core investment management data domains.
* Provide domain leadership for Security Master, Holdings, Benchmarks, Portfolio, Performance, Risk, Exposure, and Reference Data.
* Define and standardize business rules, data definitions, relationships, and data structures across investment data platforms.
* Ensure data solutions accurately reflect business processes, regulatory requirements, and investment workflows.

**Solution Design \& Development**

* Partner with engineering and architecture teams to design scalable and reusable investment data solutions.
* Translate complex business and operational requirements into detailed functional and technical specifications.
* Guide data modeling, integration, and implementation decisions for strategic investment data initiatives.
* Support the resolution of complex data challenges involving cross\-domain relationships, historical data, and data quality issues.

**Engineering Leadership**

* Lead and develop a team of data engineers based in Bangalore, India, responsible for delivering enterprise investment data capabilities.
* Provide leadership, coaching, prioritization, and business context to the team while partnering closely with engineering leadership for technical implementation decisions.
* Ensure solutions align with business objectives, investment data requirements, and delivery commitments.
* Collaborate with engineering and architecture teams to support design decisions, execution planning, and successful delivery outcomes.
* Foster strong team engagement, accountability, and continuous improvement across delivery initiatives.
* Own production operations for the critical data products, including on\-call/incident response post\-incident reviews, and continuous reliability improvements.

**Stakeholder Partnership**

* Act as a key interface between business stakeholders and engineering teams.
* Collaborate with investment teams, operations, analytics, and technology partners to ensure successful delivery outcomes.
* Facilitate alignment on requirements, priorities, and implementation approaches.
* Contribute to strategic planning and roadmap discussions for investment data initiatives.

**Data Quality \& Governance**

* Champion high standards for data quality, consistency, traceability, and operational reliability.
* Establish domain\-specific validation rules and quality controls.
* Support governance initiatives through strong domain expertise and business context.
* Drive continuous improvement of investment data assets and processes.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Establishes strong domain leadership for enterprise investment data capabilities.
* Builds a high\-performing engineering team with deep understanding of investment data.
* Improves the quality, consistency, and usability of investment data across the organization.
* Accelerates delivery by providing clear domain direction and technical guidance.
* Becomes the trusted partner to engineering leadership for investment data design and implementation decisions.

**What We Value**

These skills will help you succeed in this role\-


* 15\+ years of experience in asset management, institutional investment management, investment operations, or investment technology.
* Deep expertise in investment management data domains, including:


	+ Security Master
	+ Holdings
	+ Benchmarks
	+ Portfolio Data
	+ Performance \& Attribution
	+ Risk \& Exposure
	+ Reference Data
* Strong understanding of front\-office, middle\-office, and investment operations workflows.
* Experience designing and implementing enterprise data solutions in an investment management environment.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, data modeling, and data engineering principles.
* Proven experience leading teams of engineers and technical professionals.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.

**Education \& Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Finance, or related discipline.
* Experience working within a leading asset management or institutional investment management organization.
* Experience supporting portfolio management, investment research, risk management, performance measurement, or client reporting platforms.
* Familiarity with modern cloud\-based data and analytics platforms like Databricks and/or Snowflake.
* Experience participating in enterprise data modernization or transformation programs.
* CFA, FRM, CAIA, or similar industry certifications preferred.

title: Senior Port Infrastructure Engineer
description:
* Permanent Contract


* Mid\-Senior Level


* Bengaluru


* Technical Engineering

  
About Us  

  

Egis is an international player active in architecture, consulting, construction engineering and mobility services. We create and operate intelligent infrastructures and buildings that respond to the climate emergency and contribute to more balanced, sustainable and resilient territorial development. Operating in 100 countries, Egis puts the expertise of its 19,500 employees at the service of its clients and develops cutting\-edge innovations accessible to all projects. Through its wide range of activities, Egis is a key player in the collective organisation of society and the living environment of citizens all over the world.


With 3,500 employees across 8 countries in the Middle East, Egis has delivered over 700 complex development projects, stimulating economic growth and enhancing quality of life. Ranked among the top ten firms in the Middle East by Engineering News Record (ENR), Egis is committed to sustainable development. The Group’s operations in the Middle East are built on strategic acquisitions and a deep understanding of local market conditions. Egis has long history of providing comprehensive engineering, consulting, and project management services makes it a trusted partner for regional governments, investors, and developers.

  

  

About the Role  

  

**Senior Port Infrastructure Engineer**


**Position Summary**


The **Senior Port Infrastructure Engineer** will be responsible for the planning, design, technical coordination, and delivery of port, marine, and associated landside infrastructure projects. The role requires strong civil and maritime engineering expertise, with particular emphasis on **port infrastructure, marine structures, terminal facilities, pavement and utility systems, and multidisciplinary design coordination**.


The position will support projects from feasibility and concept development through detailed design, tender documentation, construction support, and commissioning. The engineer will work closely with clients, port operators, contractors, specialist consultants, and multidisciplinary engineering teams.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Port \& Marine Infrastructure Design**


* Lead and undertake engineering design for port and marine infrastructure, including:
	+ Quay walls and berthing structures
	+ Jetties, piers, dolphins, and access trestles
	+ Ro\-Ro ramps and ferry facilities
	+ Breakwaters and coastal protection works
	+ Revetments and shoreline structures
	+ Dredging and reclamation works
	+ Port basins, navigation channels, and turning circles
	+ Container, bulk, general cargo, and multipurpose terminal infrastructure
* Develop engineering solutions considering vessel characteristics, operational requirements, geotechnical conditions, marine environment, constructability, durability, and whole\-life performance.
* Review and coordinate structural, geotechnical, coastal, pavement, drainage, utilities, and marine systems designs.

**Landside Port Infrastructure**


* Develop and review designs for:
	+ Heavy\-duty port pavements and container yards
	+ Internal port roads and access infrastructure
	+ Terminal drainage systems
	+ Utility corridors and service networks
	+ Rail interfaces where applicable
	+ Terminal buildings and ancillary infrastructure interfaces
	+ Gates, security infrastructure, fencing, and operational areas
* Coordinate infrastructure layouts with terminal planning and cargo\-handling equipment requirements, including STS cranes, RTGs/RMGs, mobile harbour cranes, reach stackers, conveyors, and other terminal equipment.

**Engineering Analysis \& Technical Documentation**


* Prepare and review:
	+ Feasibility and technical studies
	+ Basis of Design and design criteria
	+ Concept, preliminary, and detailed engineering designs
	+ Engineering calculations
	+ Technical specifications
	+ Design drawings
	+ Bills of quantities and cost estimates
	+ Tender documentation
	+ Technical reports and design submissions
* Undertake technical evaluations and option studies to identify appropriate engineering solutions.
* Ensure designs comply with relevant international and local standards, codes, client requirements, and good maritime engineering practice.

**Tender \& Procurement Support**


* Support preparation of **EPC, Design\-Build, and traditional design\-bid\-build tender packages**.
* Prepare scopes of work, technical specifications, drawings, schedules, and employer's requirements.
* Review contractor and consultant technical proposals.
* Participate in technical bid evaluations, clarifications, and tender negotiations.
* Review contractor design proposals, methodologies, value\-engineering proposals, and alternative technical solutions.

**Construction \& Site Support**


* Provide engineering support during construction.
* Review:
	+ Contractor design submissions
	+ Shop drawings
	+ Method statements
	+ Material submissions
	+ RFIs and technical queries
	+ Temporary works proposals
* Participate in site inspections and technical meetings as required.
* Assist in resolving design and construction interface issues.
* Review design changes and assess their technical, cost, programme, and operational implications.
* Support testing, commissioning, handover, and close\-out activities.

**Multidisciplinary Coordination**


* Coordinate with:
	+ Structural engineers
	+ Geotechnical engineers
	+ Coastal and hydraulic engineers
	+ Dredging and reclamation specialists
	+ Terminal planners
	+ Roads and pavement engineers
	+ Drainage and utilities engineers
	+ Electrical and mechanical engineers
	+ Environmental specialists
	+ BIM/CAD teams
	+ Quantity surveyors and cost consultants
* Manage technical interfaces between marine structures, landside infrastructure, terminal operations, and cargo\-handling systems.
* Participate in design reviews, workshops, HAZID/risk reviews, constructability reviews, and value\-engineering exercises.

**Technical Leadership**


* Provide technical guidance to engineers, designers, and CAD/BIM personnel.
* Review engineering calculations, drawings, specifications, and reports prepared by junior engineers.
* Ensure appropriate QA/QC procedures are implemented.
* Identify technical risks and develop mitigation measures.
* Promote technically robust, safe, constructible, sustainable, and cost\-effective engineering solutions.
* Contribute to development and implementation of engineering standards and best practices within the port and maritime team.

  

  

What do we need from you  

  

**Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in **Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Marine Engineering**, or a closely related discipline.
* Master's degree in Civil, Structural, Maritime, Coastal, Geotechnical, or Port Engineering is advantageous.
* Chartered Engineer, Professional Engineer, or equivalent professional registration is preferred.

**Experience**


* Typically **10–15\+ years of relevant civil/infrastructure engineering experience**, with substantial experience in **ports, maritime infrastructure, marine structures, or major heavy civil infrastructure**.
* Demonstrable experience in the design and/or delivery of major port and marine projects.
* Experience through multiple project stages, preferably including feasibility, concept design, detailed design, tendering, and construction.
* Middle East/GCC port infrastructure experience is advantageous.
* Experience working for an engineering consultant, port authority, developer, or major marine contractor is desirable.

**Technical Knowledge**


Strong knowledge of several of the following areas is expected:


* Quay wall and marine structure design
* Berthing and mooring infrastructure
* Dredging and reclamation
* Breakwaters and coastal protection
* Port pavement and heavy\-duty yard design
* Geotechnical considerations for marine structures
* Marine durability and corrosion protection
* Fender and mooring systems
* Port drainage and utilities
* Terminal infrastructure planning
* Construction methodologies for marine works
* Design risk management and constructability
* International maritime and civil engineering standards

Familiarity with relevant guidance and standards such as **PIANC, BS/Eurocodes, ACI, AASHTO, CIRIA, ROM, OCIMF** and applicable local authority requirements is desirable.

description:

**About Carrier**



Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. **About Role** Builds enterprise data and AI capabilities to enable secure, scalable, and high\-quality data\-driven decisions. Applies AI/ML, automation, and strong governance to drive efficiency and business value.



\#\#


### **Role Responsibilities:**


* \#\#\# Platform Engineering \& Architecture


**GCP platform architecture:** Lead the design and implementation of scalable AI, data, and automation platforms on Google Cloud Platform, including secure landing zones, environment strategy, IAM, networking, monitoring, deployment patterns, shared services, and enterprise governance controls.


* **Cloud\-native AI engineering:** Build and operationalize cloud\-native AI/ML solutions using Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, service accounts, APIs, and related managed services.
* **Enterprise integration patterns:** Architect secure integration patterns across APIs, enterprise data sources, event\-driven workflows, databases, data pipelines, model endpoints, agent workflows, and third\-party systems while ensuring scalability, maintainability, security, and compliance.

### **2\. Automation \& Agentic AI**


* **Automation and orchestration:** Design and implement robust automation workflows using Python, TypeScript, APIs, serverless services, CI/CD pipelines, event\-driven design, infrastructure automation, and cloud\-native orchestration patterns.
* **Agentic AI and AgentOps:** Lead the development and operational governance of AI agents, multi\-agent workflows, tool calling, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, agent monitoring, evaluation, safety guardrails, access controls, incident response, and production support processes.

### **3\. AI Platform Evaluation \& Assessment**


* **AI platform evaluation and adoption:** Evaluate enterprise AI platforms and productivity tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Dataiku, coding assistants, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, Codex, and other emerging AI tools as good\-to\-have capabilities, validating their architecture fit, governance readiness, security posture, integration model, and business value.

### **3\. Governance, Security \& Performance**


* **Cloud security and governance:** Define and enforce security controls across GCP, including IAM, least privilege access, network security, encryption, secrets management, audit logging, policy controls, data protection, and responsible AI governance standards.
* **Production reliability:** Establish monitoring, alerting, logging, tracing, incident response, performance tuning, release readiness, operational runbooks, and support practices for AI, data, and cloud platform services.
* **FinOps and optimization:** Lead usage analytics, budget controls, cost allocation, model and API usage optimization, resource right\-sizing, and executive\-level reporting to improve cloud and AI platform cost efficiency.

### **4\. Technical Leadership \& Team Enablement**



Lead and mentor junior engineers by providing hands\-on technical direction, reviewing architecture designs and code, defining reusable engineering patterns, conducting knowledge\-sharing sessions, assigning technical tasks, removing blockers, and ensuring consistent delivery quality across AI platform, GCP, automation, MLOps, LLMOps, and AgentOps initiatives.


### **5\. MLOps \& LLMOps**



Lead the operationalization of ML, generative AI, and agentic AI solutions across enterprise platforms. This includes MLOps for model deployment, lifecycle management, monitoring, retraining support, and release governance; LLMOps for prompt/version management, model evaluation, RAG quality, safety controls, usage tracking, and responsible AI oversight; and AgentOps for agent workflow observability, tool usage governance, guardrails, incident management, and production support. Ensure AI platforms are secure, observable, cost\-efficient, resilient, and production\-ready.**Overall experience:** 10\-12 years of overall technology experience across cloud engineering, AI/ML platforms, data platforms, automation, enterprise application development, or platform architecture.**Mandatory specialized experience:** 4\-5 years of hands\-on experience as an AI Engineer or AI Platforms Engineer with strong exposure to Google Cloud Platform, MLOps, LLMOps, AgentOps, and production\-grade AI solution delivery.**GCP technical depth:** Strong experience with Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, IAM, VPC, Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, Pub/Sub, APIs, service accounts, data pipelines, and enterprise\-grade deployment patterns.**AI platform engineering:** Strong understanding of generative AI, model lifecycle, prompt lifecycle, RAG, embeddings, vector search, model evaluation, responsible AI controls, AI governance, observability, scalability, and platform reliability.**MLOps, LLMOps, and AgentOps:** Proven experience with model deployment, CI/CD for ML and AI workloads, prompt and model versioning, evaluation pipelines, agent monitoring, tool orchestration, guardrails, usage tracking, incident response, and production support for AI systems.**Core engineering:** Advanced proficiency in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, APIs, infrastructure automation, data ingestion pipelines, backend services, and integrations with AI/ML and LLM APIs.**DevOps and platform operations:** Proven experience with GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure\-as\-code, environment management, release governance, observability, operational readiness, and production support for enterprise platforms.**Technical leadership:** Proven ability to lead junior engineers, mentor team members, review technical designs and code, define standards, assign technical work, remove blockers, and drive high\-quality delivery.


### **Role Purpose**


* We are seeking a senior Lead AI Platforms Engineer with 10\-12 years of overall technology experience, including 4\-5 years of hands\-on experience in Google Cloud Platform, AI engineering, MLOps, LLMOps, and AgentOps. This role will lead the design, implementation, governance, and operationalization of enterprise AI platform capabilities on GCP.The role requires deep technical expertise across AI platform engineering, cloud\-native architecture, generative AI, data integration, automation, DevOps, observability, security, governance, and cost optimization. The engineer will define scalable platform patterns, mentor junior engineers, review solution designs and code, establish engineering standards, and ensure AI solutions are secure, reliable, production\-ready, measurable, and aligned with enterprise governance expectations.

### **Minimum Requirements**


* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; master’s degree preferred.
* **Overall experience:** 10\-12 years of relevant technology experience in cloud engineering, AI/ML platforms, data platforms, automation, enterprise application development, or platform architecture.
* **MLOps, LLMOps, and AgentOps:** Strong understanding of model deployment, prompt lifecycle management, model and agent evaluation, tool orchestration, agent monitoring, guardrails, observability, incident management, and production support for AI systems.
* **Security and governance:** Strong understanding of IAM, access control, data privacy, compliance, encryption, secrets management, audit logging, responsible AI, and cloud governance principles.
* Experience or Exposure to AWS, Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Dataiku, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex, Claude, or other enterprise AI and coding assistant tools

### **Benefits**

title: Engineer I - Field Service
description:
### **Job Description**


**Brief Job Description:**



Job Title


**Service Engineer – Precision Air Conditioning (PAC)**



Department



Service Operations – Thermal Management



Reporting To



Service Manager / Regional Service Manager


### **Job Summary**



The PAC Service Engineer is responsible for installation, commissioning, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repairs, and customer support for Precision Air Conditioning (PAC) systems and associated cooling equipment. The role requires ensuring maximum equipment uptime, meeting SLA commitments, and providing excellent customer service at data centers, telecom sites, IT facilities, and commercial establishments.



Key Responsibilities Installation \& Commissioning


* Perform installation, testing, and commissioning of PAC units and associated cooling systems.
* Verify site readiness and ensure compliance with engineering drawings and safety requirements.
* Conduct performance testing and prepare commissioning reports.
* Coordinate with project teams, customers, and subcontractors during project execution.


Preventive Maintenance


* Execute scheduled preventive maintenance activities for PAC units, CRAC/CRAH units, chillers, condensers, CDU, FWU, and related systems.
* Inspect compressors, condensers, evaporators, fans, control panels, sensors, and refrigerant circuits.
* Submit maintenance reports and recommendations for improving equipment reliability.


Breakdown \& Troubleshooting


* Diagnose and rectify faults in electrical, mechanical, refrigeration, and control systems.
* Analyze alarms and operational abnormalities using controller logs and monitoring systems.
* Ensure timely closure of breakdown calls as per SLA commitments.
* Support emergency and critical site requirements during breakdown situations.


Customer Support


* Provide technical support and guidance to customers.
* Maintain professional communication during service visits.
* Ensure customer concerns are addressed promptly and effectively.
* Prepare service reports and obtain customer sign\-off upon activity completion.


Spare Parts \& Inventory Management


* Identify and recommend replacement parts and consumables.
* Maintain service inventory and tools in good condition.
* Support quotation preparation for repairs and spare replacement requirements.


Safety \& Compliance


* Follow all EHS (Environment, Health \& Safety) guidelines.
* Ensure proper usage of PPE during service activities.
* Maintain compliance with customer safety regulations and permit systems.
* Report unsafe conditions and incidents immediately.

### **Required Qualifications**


* Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Refrigeration \& Air Conditioning, or related field.
* ITI (RAC/Electrical) with relevant experience may also be considered.

### **Experience**


* 2 to 8 years of experience in HVAC, Precision Cooling, or Critical Cooling Systems.
* Experience in data centers, telecom infrastructure, IT facilities, healthcare facilities, or commercial buildings preferred.


Technical Skills


* Good understanding of refrigeration cycle and HVAC principles.
* Experience with:
* Precision Air Conditioning (PAC) Units
* CRAC / CRAH Systems
* Chilled Water Systems
* DX Cooling Systems
* Air\-Cooled and Water\-Cooled Condensers
* CDU and FWU Systems
* Ability to troubleshoot:
* Compressors
* EEV/TEV Valves
* Refrigerant Circuits
* PLC and Microprocessor Controllers
* Electrical Panels and Drives
* Sensors and Communication Networks
* Knowledge of refrigerants and safe handling procedures.
* Familiarity with BMS and remote monitoring systems.


Key Competencies


* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Customer\-focused approach.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently at remote sites.

title: Sr Manager - Reliability & Root Cause Analysis
description:
We are seeking an experienced Manager \- Reliability \& Root Cause Analysis to lead a multidisciplinary engineering team within the Fleet Intelligence \& Reliability organization. The team is responsible for identifying systemic fleet risks, determining the physical and systemic causes of complex failures, and ensuring that corrective and preventive actions deliver measurable and sustainable reliability improvement across the global Solar and Storage installed fleet.
  

This role owns the technical governance of Root Cause Analyses for complex, high\-impact, recurring, and fleet\-wide issues. The manager will ensure that investigations are evidence\-based, technically rigorous, and completed with clear accountability from initial containment through corrective\-action validation and fleet\-risk closure.
  

The leader will manage engineers across relevant disciplines, which may include power electronics, electrical systems, mechanical systems, embedded software, plant controls, and systems engineering. The position requires close partnership with Fleet Performance \& Analytics, Product Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Project Engineering, Field Operations, and commercial teams to convert fleet experience into product and operational improvement.
**Job Description**
===================


**Roles and Responsibilities**
==============================


* Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary engineering team responsible for fleet reliability, failure investigation, and Root Cause Analysis.
* Own and continuously improve the RCA governance process, including issue prioritization, ownership assignment, technical reviews, milestones, escalation, corrective\-action tracking, validation, and closure criteria.
* Lead investigations of complex, high\-impact, systemic, and recurring failures affecting solar inverters, battery energy storage systems, plant controls, power conversion equipment, and associated interfaces.
* Ensure investigations are grounded in verified evidence, operating data, event logs, inspection results, failure reproduction, laboratory analysis, engineering calculations, and appropriate structured problem\-solving methods.
* Differentiate failure symptoms, direct physical causes, contributing factors, systemic causes, and organizational causes, ensuring that conclusions are supported by evidence.
* Drive immediate containment, short\-term mitigation, and permanent corrective and preventive actions with the relevant engineering and operational owners.
* Prioritize investigations using safety exposure, customer impact, availability loss, recurrence, fleet population, warranty exposure, and financial consequence.
* Maintain a fleet\-level view of failure modes and systemic risk across products, projects, regions, configurations, software versions, suppliers, and operating environments.
* Partner with Fleet Performance \& Analytics to use fleet data, trends, event signatures, and risk models to detect emerging issues, quantify exposure, and verify corrective\-action effectiveness.
* Translate field and fleet learning into recommendations for product requirements, design changes, validation plans, software releases, manufacturing processes, supplier controls, maintenance strategies, and technical documentation.
* Provide technical leadership during critical fleet events, customer escalations, and executive\-level issue reviews.
* Ensure customer\-facing and internal RCA reports are accurate, evidence\-based, clear, and delivered in accordance with committed milestones.
* Develop and maintain reusable engineering knowledge, including RCA standards, failure libraries, lessons learned, troubleshooting guides, technical advisories, and investigation templates.
* Support the definition and deployment of Change, Modification, and Upgrade actions resulting from fleet reliability findings.
* Establish and monitor meaningful metrics such as RCA cycle time, milestone adherence, recurrence rate, corrective\-action closure, investigation backlog, and quantified fleet\-risk reduction.
* Promote a culture of safety, technical rigor, accountability, collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================


* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Control Systems Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related technical field.
* Demonstratable experience in engineering, reliability, failure analysis, product engineering, installed\-base engineering, or a related technical function.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex technical investigations or RCAs involving multidisciplinary systems.
* Demonstrated experience leading engineers, technical teams, or significant cross\-functional engineering programs.
* Experience with power generation, renewable energy, battery energy storage, power conversion, industrial automation, or comparable complex industrial equipment.
* Ability and willingness to travel internationally as required.

**Desired Characteristics**
===========================


* Advanced degree in engineering, reliability, systems engineering, or a related discipline.
* Previous people\-leadership experience within a global engineering or technical organization.
* Strong knowledge of solar inverters, battery energy storage systems, power electronics, plant controls, electrical protection, thermal management, and industrial communication networks.
* Experience applying structured investigation methodologies such as Fault Tree Analysis, 5 Whys, Ishikawa analysis, 8D, Kepner\-Tregoe, or Failure Mode and Effects Analysis.
* Knowledge of reliability engineering, failure mechanisms, accelerated testing, design validation, reliability growth, and corrective\-action effectiveness assessment.
* Experience analyzing operational data, waveforms, alarms, event logs, failed components, inspection evidence, and intervention history.
* Strong systems thinking, technical judgment, and ability to make risk\-based decisions with incomplete or evolving information.
* Proven ability to influence Product Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Operations, and commercial teams in a matrixed environment.
* Strong customer\-facing skills and the ability to communicate sensitive technical findings with clarity, credibility, and appropriate transparency.
* Ability to manage multiple high\-priority investigations across a global fleet.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Self\-starting attitude with the ability to establish structure, set priorities, develop people, and drive issues through sustainable closure.

**Additional Information**
==========================


**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

What truly sets us apart is our culture—rooted in Truly Human Leadership, a philosophy that prioritizes the well\-being and growth of every individual. We measure success by the way we touch lives, not just by financial results.


In India, Barry\-Wehmiller operates as a hub of innovation and collaboration through our Global Competency Center (GCC) and other strategic functions. The GCC houses centers of excellence in engineering, content management, sourcing, software development, global IT operations, and shared financial services—providing critical support to Barry\-Wehmiller divisions worldwide.


**Our culture is built on:**

* Ownership – Drive features end\-to\-end, from design to deployment.
* Flexibility – A friendly, results\-oriented environment that respects your time.
* Empowerment – Your ideas matter, and your work creates visible impact.
* Learning and Growth – Tackle complex challenges alongside passionate peers, with continuous support for your development.

**Career Development and Global Exposure**

  

At Barry\-Wehmiller, your growth is our priority. You’ll have access to world\-class learning programs, leadership development opportunities, and mentorship from industry experts. Our global footprint means you’ll collaborate with teams across continents, gaining exposure to diverse markets, cutting\-edge technologies, and best practices from around the world. Whether you aspire to deepen your technical expertise or take on leadership roles, we provide the resources and support to help you thrive.


If you’re ready to bring your best thinking to a high\-impact, future\-focused environment—where long\-term stability meets start\-up agility—and be part of a company that cares deeply about people, we’d love to hear from you.


**Job Description**

We are looking for a **Senior Engineer – Controls** with 8\+ years of experience in the design, development, modification, migration, integration, and implementation of **PLC and HMI/SCADA systems for discrete machinery and equipment** .


The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on experience with a combination of **Siemens, Allen\-Bradley (Rockwell Automation), and Beckhoff** automation platforms. Experience in **printing, paper converting, packaging, textile, or other machinery/OEM industries** is highly preferred.


The engineer should be able to take a systems approach to understand the overall machine design, mechanical functions, electrical architecture, control philosophy, safety systems, and automation requirements, and develop robust PLC and HMI programs ensuring the overall functional quality and performance of the machinery/equipment.


The role will be responsible for the interface between **electrical hardware, PLC software, HMI/SCADA, drives, motion systems, instrumentation, and machine\-level automation** .


**Technical Skills**
--------------------

### **PLC \& HMI Platforms**

Strong hands\-on experience in one or more of the following platforms, with the ability to work across multiple automation platforms:


* **Siemens S7\-1200 / S7\-1500 PLCs**
* **Siemens Comfort Panels / Unified Comfort Panels**
* **Allen\-Bradley / Rockwell Automation PLCs**
	+ ControlLogix
	+ CompactLogix
* **Beckhoff PLC / IPC\-based control systems**
	+ TwinCAT 3
	+ EtherCAT
* Experience with HMI/SCADA development and integration across Siemens, Allen\-Bradley, and Beckhoff platforms.

### **PLC \& HMI Development**

* Hands\-on experience developing **PLC and HMI programs from scratch** based on URS, functional specifications, and client standards.
* Ability to understand and develop PLC programs using:
	+ Ladder Logic
	+ Function Block Diagram
	+ Structured Text
	+ Sequential Function Chart
* Develop machine sequences, interlocks, alarms, permissives, recipes, diagnostics, and operator interfaces.
* Interface PLC programs with HMI/SCADA systems.
* Experience in modifying, debugging, migrating, and optimizing existing PLC/HMI programs.
* Experience with **machine\-level automation and discrete manufacturing applications** .
* HMI scripting/programming experience using **JavaScript, C\#, or similar technologies** is an added advantage.

**Siemens Automation**
----------------------

* Strong hands\-on experience with **Siemens S7\-1500 PLCs** .
* Experience with **TIA Portal V15\.1 or above** .
* TIA Portal V17/V18/V19 or later experience preferred.
* Siemens Comfort and Unified Comfort HMI development.
* PLC/HMI programming, troubleshooting, commissioning, and debugging.
* Experience with Siemens drives and motion systems is preferred.

**Allen\-Bradley / Rockwell Automation**
----------------------------------------

* Hands\-on experience with **Allen\-Bradley PLCs** .
* Experience with **ControlLogix and/or CompactLogix** platforms.
* Rockwell Studio 5000 / RSLogix programming experience.
* Allen\-Bradley HMI experience using **FactoryTalk View** is preferred.
* Experience with Rockwell drives, I/O, communication networks, and motion systems is an advantage.

**Beckhoff Automation**
-----------------------

* Hands\-on experience with **Beckhoff PLC/control systems** .
* Experience with **TwinCAT 3** programming and development.
* Knowledge of **EtherCAT** communication and distributed I/O systems.
* Experience with Beckhoff IPCs, motion control, servo systems, and drives is preferred.
* Experience developing machine control applications using Structured Text is an advantage.

**Industrial Communication \& Networking**
------------------------------------------

Good understanding of industrial communication protocols and networking, including:


* PROFINET / PROFIBUS
* EtherNet/IP
* EtherCAT
* AS\-i
* CAN / CANopen
* DeviceNet
* Modbus TCP/RTU
* OPC UA
* Other industrial Ethernet and fieldbus protocols

Ability to configure, troubleshoot, and integrate PLCs, remote I/O, drives, HMIs, sensors, and other automation devices over industrial networks.


**Drives, Motors \& Motion Control**
------------------------------------

* Knowledge of selection and application of motors, motor controllers, VFDs, servo drives, and motion\-control systems.
* Understanding of:
	+ Motor horsepower
	+ Torque
	+ Speed range
	+ Gear ratios
	+ Reduction ratios
	+ Acceleration/deceleration
* Experience with Siemens, Allen\-Bradley, or Beckhoff drives is preferred.
* Basic understanding of servo positioning and motion\-control applications.

**Instrumentation \& Control Components**
-----------------------------------------

Good understanding of selection and application of industrial control components, including:


* Sensors for flow, pressure, level, temperature, position, speed, counters, motion, vision, etc.
* Digital and analog sensors
* Proximity and photoelectric sensors
* Encoders
* Transducers
* Solenoid valves
* Relays
* Contactors
* On/Off control devices
* Analog I/O and signal conditioning
* A/D and D/A conversion
* I/P and P/I conversion

Understanding of sensor characteristics such as accuracy, precision, response time, repeatability, reliability, range, and environmental/temperature effects.


**FAT, SAT \& Commissioning**
-----------------------------

* Develop automation test cases and procedures for **Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT)** and **Site Acceptance Testing (SAT)** .
* Participate in FAT/SAT with customers and project teams.
* Hands\-on experience in machine installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and start\-up.
* Ability to troubleshoot PLC, HMI, drives, I/O, communication, and machine sequence issues.
* Experience with remote commissioning and troubleshooting tools.
* Willingness to travel to customer sites for commissioning and project support.

**Standards \& Compliance**
---------------------------

Working knowledge of applicable industry codes, standards, and regulations such as:


* ANSI
* ISA
* NEC
* NEMA
* NFPA
* OSHA
* UL

Experience working with machine safety systems and safety PLCs is an added advantage.


**Tool Skills**
===============

### **Mandatory / Core**

* **Siemens TIA Portal – V15\.1 or above**
* Siemens S7\-1500 PLC
* Siemens Comfort / Unified Comfort HMI
* **Allen\-Bradley / Rockwell Studio 5000**
* ControlLogix / CompactLogix
* **Beckhoff TwinCAT 3**
* EtherCAT

### **Preferred**

* TIA Portal V17\+
* FactoryTalk View
* Siemens / Rockwell / Beckhoff drives and motion systems
* OPC UA
* Industrial Ethernet networking
* HMI scripting / C\# / JavaScript
* EPLAN or similar electrical engineering tools

**Education \& Experience**
===========================

* Bachelor's degree in **Electrical \& Electronics Engineering (EEE), Electronics \& Communication Engineering (ECE), Instrumentation, or related engineering discipline** .
* **8\+ years of experience in industrial automation and controls engineering.**
* Strong hands\-on experience in PLC and HMI programming.
* Experience with **a combination of Siemens, Allen\-Bradley, and Beckhoff platforms** is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience developing PLC/HMI programs **from scratch** .
* Experience in machinery/OEM applications is highly preferred.
* Experience in **printing, packaging, paper converting, textile, or other discrete machinery industries** is an advantage.
* Experience in machine commissioning and customer\-site support is preferred.

**Key Result Areas**
====================

* Configure automation hardware and software according to project design specifications.
* Develop PLC and HMI programs from scratch based on machine automation requirements.
* Integrate Siemens, Allen\-Bradley, and Beckhoff automation platforms with machine hardware and control systems.
* Ensure optimal performance, reliability, quality, and responsiveness of PLC/HMI applications.
* Troubleshoot PLC, HMI, drives, motion, I/O, and industrial communication issues.
* Follow software development, change\-management, and version\-control procedures.
* Maintain proper documentation of PLC/HMI software and project changes.
* Manage assigned projects and deliver according to agreed schedules and scope.
* Communicate project progress, technical issues, and risks to project stakeholders.
* Support FAT, SAT, machine start\-up, commissioning, and customer acceptance.
* Provide technical support to internal teams and customers as required.

**Soft Skills**
===============

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Logical and systematic approach to problem\-solving.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Ability to understand complex machine sequences and identify key technical issues.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.
* Strong customer\-facing and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and changing project requirements.
* Willingness to learn and work across multiple automation platforms.

**Travel**
==========

Occasional domestic and/or international travel may be required, up to **15%** , for customer meetings, FAT, SAT, installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and project support.


**Preferred Candidate Profile**
-------------------------------

The ideal candidate will be a **multi\-platform Controls Engineer** with strong practical experience in:


**Siemens \+ Allen\-Bradley \+ Beckhoff**

with hands\-on capability in:


**PLC Programming HMI Development Drives/Motion Industrial Communication Machine Integration FAT/SAT Commissioning**

Experience with **OEM/discrete machinery** , particularly printing, packaging, paper converting, or textile machinery, will be a strong advantage.

 Education
   

  

* BE/BTech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Telecommunications or equivalent qualification.

 The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience in

description:
Job Title: Production Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) – Digital Payments
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are seeking a highly technical and driven Production SRE Engineer to manage and monitor mission\-critical payment platforms including UPI, IMPS, and Payment Hub systems\& various Payment Applications.
   

  

 The role focuses on ensuring high availability, low latency, and seamless transaction experience for customers. The incumbent will collaborate with cross\-functional teams (Engineering, Business, Compliance) and external regulators (RBI, NPCI) to maintain resilient and scalable payment infrastructure.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Production Support \& Incident Management
   

  

* Provide L2/L3 production support for UPI, IMPS, and Payment Hub platforms \& various Payment Applications.
* Diagnose, triage, and resolve transaction failures, timeouts, and API disruptions.
* Lead and participate in Major Incident Management (MIM) calls and ensure timely stakeholder communication.
* Manage incidents, service requests, and problem tickets via Jira, ServiceNow.
* Provide regular updates to internal stakeholders and regulatory bodies (NPCI/RBI) during critical issues.


 Reliability Engineering \& RCA
   

  

* Perform deep\-dive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring payment and system issues.
* Implement preventive and corrective measures to improve system stability.
* Drive SRE best practices including error budgets, SLIs/SLOs, and system resilience.
* Experience in managing DR Drills \& Documentations.
* Reviewing the SOPs \& its relative documentations.


 Monitoring, Observability \& System Engineering
   

  

* Monitor key performance indicators: \- Transaction success rates
* Latency and response times
* Failure trends and retries
* Build and maintain dashboards using: \- ELK Stack, Grafana, Kibana, Splunk, Datadog, Prometheus
* Establish proactive alerting and anomaly detection mechanisms.
* Work closely with engineering teams to design and optimize: \- High\-throughput payment switches
* Routing logic
* Settlement and reconciliation systems
* Understand and support UPI architecture, IMPS rails, and payment orchestration layers \& various Payment Applications.
* Trace end\-to\-end transaction lifecycle across distributed systems.


 External Partner \& Regulatory Coordination
   

  

* Coordinate with NPCI, partner banks, and TPAPs during outages, reconciliation issues, or network disruptions.
* Lead integrations and ensure seamless onboarding of ecosystem participants.
* Ensure compliance with: \- RBI guidelines and data localization mandates
* NPCI operational and technical standards


 Technical Skills \& Expertise
   

  

 Payments Domain Knowledge
   

  

* Strong expertise in: \- UPI architecture and flows
* IMPS rails
* Payment gateway / switch systems
* Payment Hub orchestration \& various Payment Applications.


 Core Technical Skills
   

  

* Advanced SQL proficiency (joins, aggregations, stored procedures)
* Strong hands\-on experience in: \- Linux/UNIX systems administration
* Shell scripting
* Ability to: \- Read , Write and interpret All types documentation (SOPs, workflows, etc.)
* Understand database schemas
* Analyse system architecture and latency


 Monitoring \& Observability Tools
   

  

* Hands\-on expertise with: \- ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana)
* Grafana, Prometheus
* Splunk, Datadog


 DevOps \& Cloud
   

  

* Experience with: \- CI/CD pipelines, Containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Cloud platforms: \- AWS / GCP / Azure


 Key Competencies

**Debug \& Stability Analysis:**

**Required Skills**

• Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with ability to handle complex stability issues.
  

• Proficiency in C/C\+\+ programming; familiarity with Assembly is a plus.
  

• Expert\-level understanding of Linux internals (kernel, device drivers, memory management) and RTOS fundamentals (scheduling, synchronization).

 A leading low\-latency trading firm is expanding its Mumbai data center operations team. They’re looking for a hands\-on Data Center Engineer who understands the physical and network layers of ultra\-low\-latency infrastructure and can keep mission\-critical trading systems running at peak performance.
 



  





 This is not a standard DC ops role – you’ll be working in a performance\-driven environment where milliseconds matter and operational excellence directly impacts trading outcomes.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Install, rack, cable, and configure servers, network devices, and storage in a low\-latency data center environment
* Plan and optimise rack layouts, power distribution, cabling pathways, and patching schedules to support latency\-sensitive workloads
* Perform hardware diagnostics, break/fix, and RMA coordination with vendors to minimise downtime
* Support deployment and maintenance of low\-latency networking gear (switches, NICs, optics, transceivers, fiber infrastructure)
* Work closely with network, systems, and trading infrastructure engineers on deployments, upgrades, and capacity planning

* Follow strict change management, security, and compliance processes in a regulated trading environment



  





**Must\-Have Experience** 



* 4\+ years of hands\-on data center engineering experience, ideally in a trading, fintech, or HPC environment
* Strong practical knowledge of server hardware, network devices, and storage systems in production DCs
* Experience with fiber optics, copper cabling, transceivers, and basic optical testing
* Familiarity with Linux\-based systems and basic CLI troubleshooting

title: IT Manager
description:
IT Manager \| Vantrock Real Assets Private Limited \| Mumbai Metropolitan Region
 



  
 



 Own the systems a real assets platform runs on — the accounting and business applications, the devices, the network, the security — and implement the ones it does not have yet. One IT manager commanding vendors, not running a department.
 



  
 



 A note before you read on. The team structure, reporting lines, direct reports, seat titles and hiring entity described in this brief reflect the platform's current plan and may change as the platform builds out. Compensation and incentive structures are confirmed in the offer, not here.
 



  
 



 REPORTS TO: Chief Financial Officer · until that seat is filled, the General Manager — Finance \& Accounts · EXPERIENCE: 8–12 years in IT and business\-systems management, including at least one ERP or accounting\-system implementation you ran
 



  
 



 ABOUT VANTROCK
 



 Vantrock is India's independent, operator\-led real assets platform — real assets only — with logistics and industrial as the first phase of its growth.
 



 Founded by Anshul Singhal, Founder \& CEO, who has built three institutional platforms from zero and is building the fourth on his own capital: 52 million sq ft delivered (32 million as developer, 20 million as contractor), 2,000\+ acres acquired, 200\+ buildings, two SEBI Category II funds run to a successful close, India's first domestic warehousing AIF and India's largest industrial real estate exit — delivered across the founder's three prior platforms.
 



  
 



 THE FINANCE \& ACCOUNTS TEAM
 



 Vantrock keeps its books in\-house. The finance function owns every number from the site to the board.
 



 Twenty\-one seats when fully built; sixteen live now, one of them already filled. Small enough that every person in it is known by name to the founder; large enough to run a platform properly. Every seat in the team is a builder's seat: the function does not exist yet in the form described here, and the people who join it now are the ones who will decide what it becomes.
 



  
 



 THE OPERATING LAYER HAS AN OWNER
 



 Vantrock runs on its dashboards. Models, trackers, the close calendar, the Asset Review pack, the matter tracker — all of it lives on the platform's operating layer, and the platform's own intelligence arm builds the tools that sit on top. But somebody has to own the layer underneath: the accounting and business applications and their implementation; the devices every person works on; the network in the office and at every site; the identities, access and security that keep a finance function's data where it belongs; the licences, the vendors and the budget.
 



  
 



 WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS
 



 A finance function of twenty\-one seats keeping its books in\-house needs an accounting system implemented properly, integrated with the platform's dashboards, secured, backed up and supported — before the first month\-end runs on it. A platform with sites to open in four cities needs each one connected and equipped on the day it does. And a company built to run on technology needs someone whose job is that the technology runs. None of that exists yet as a function. This seat is it.
 



  
 



 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 



 1\. The accounting and business systems. The finance function's system of record — selected with the Chief Financial Officer and the General Manager, implemented on a plan you run, integrated with the platform's operating layer, and supported after go\-live.
 



 2\. Implementations. Every system the platform adopts taken from decision to daily use: requirements with the function head, vendor selection, configuration, data migration, testing, training, cut\-over, hyper\-care.
 



 3\. Devices, network and sites. Every person equipped and connected; the office and every project site on a network that works; new sites live on the day they open.
 



 4\. Identity, access and security. Who can see what, enforced in the systems, not in a policy document.
 



 5\. Vendors and licences. The IT vendors, the software licences, the support contracts — scoped, negotiated, held to their service levels, and inside the budget you own.
 



 6\. Support. The first call when something does not work, and a standard for how fast it is fixed — with the platform's intelligence arm as your partner for anything that touches the product layer.
 



 7\. The technology roadmap. A written, budgeted view of what the platform will need in twelve and twenty\-four months, refreshed each quarter with the Chief Financial Officer.
 



  
 



 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



 ESSENTIAL
 



 – 8–12 years in IT management and business systems, of which a meaningful part at a mid\-sized company where you were the IT function, not a member of one.
 



 – At least one ERP or accounting\-system implementation run end to end by you — requirements to hyper\-care — for a finance team that then used it. This will be discussed in detail.
 



 – Devices, networks, identity and access, and information security managed for a distributed business — more than one office or site.
 



 – Vendor and licence management as the client: scoping, negotiating, service levels, budget.
 



 – Comfortable with a finance function's requirements — you can talk to a controller about a chart of accounts and to a payables head about approval workflows.
 



 – Hands\-on when needed, and honest about what you do not know.
 



 – Based in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region.
 



 WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT
 



 – Not a software\-development seat. The platform's product and AI tools are built by its intelligence arm; this seat runs the layer they sit on.
 



 – Not a helpdesk seat. Support is part of the job; the implementations and the security are the job.
 



 – Not a large\-team management seat. You command vendors; you do not manage a department.
 



  
 



 HOW YOU WILL WORK
 



 – Outsource the doing, own the outcome. Vendors implement and support; you command them and are accountable for the result.
 



 – Everything runs on the platform's dashboards. The asset register, the licence log, the ticket queue and the roadmap live on the operating layer.
 



 – Judgment is written down. Every implementation has a plan and a sign\-off; every access change has a record; every incident has a cause.
 



 – Mumbai Metropolitan Region, full\-time, in person, with travel to sites.
 



  
 



 COMPENSATION
 



 Vantrock benchmarks compensation against the upper quartile for the role and market, weighted toward equity for candidates who want to build with us long\-term. We discuss specific numbers in the first conversation rather than anchoring either side prematurely.
 



 Wealth creation is part of the engine, not only the salary: a performance\-linked annual bonus, and a path to ESOP\-linked incentives as the seat grows — priced to the seat and confirmed in the offer.
 



  
 



 CULTURAL FIT
 



 We're building Vantrock over a decade, not a funding cycle. We're looking for people who treat technology as the default answer rather than a supplement, who want to be co\-builders of the platform rather than employees executing instructions, and who are comfortable saying "I don't know" and "I was wrong." If you want a defined role with defined edges, this isn't the right seat. If you want to help build an institution from zero, it might be.
 



 AI proficiency is a standing requirement in every Vantrock seat. You work fluently with AI tools for research, modelling, drafting and analysis, and you build on the platform's dashboards rather than around them. A supervised AI Proficiency Test is part of the process for every seat, at every level of seniority, and we say so openly.
 



 Partner command is the second standing requirement. The books are ours, but auditors, banks, the fund administrator, valuers, law firms and system vendors are commanded by this team — briefed, held to a standard, integrated — never deferred to. We hire for judgment and accountability.
 



  
 



 HOW WE WILL ASSESS
 



 Everyone who applies hears from us within two working days. It carries two links: a fixed set of six questions answered by AI interview — about forty minutes, and the first work sample; we review it before the CV — and the Vantrock AI Proficiency Test, which every hire takes at every level. From there:
 



 1\. The Implementation conversation. The ERP or accounting system you implemented: the plan, what went wrong at cut\-over, what the finance team said six months later. With the General Manager — Finance \& Accounts, or the Chief Financial Officer once in seat.
 



 2\. A 90\-minute supervised case. A brief for a finance function of twenty seats going live on a new accounting system in ninety days, across a head office and two sites — from which you produce the implementation plan, the access model and the three risks that would derail it. Reviewed with the General Manager and the Founder \& CEO.
 



 3\. References. Two, contacted directly: one former reporting manager and one finance\-function user of a system you implemented.
 



 Once we have received your application, your AI interview and your test, we will reach out with next steps. Your application is confidential: it is seen only by the Founder's Office and the hiring lead, and nothing is shared with your current employer or referenced without your consent.
 



  
 



 TO APPLY
 



 Write to careers@vantrock.com with the subject line "IT Manager — \[your name]", and attach:
 



 – Your CV. This is mandatory — a LinkedIn profile alone is not an application; we will read your LinkedIn as well.
 



 – Your Systems Sheet — one row per system you implemented or ran: system, function served, users, your role, year, outcome. The template is available on request.
 



 – Your notice period and what you would need to see to move.
 



 – One short paragraph: the mistake most companies make in the first thirty days of an accounting\-system implementation, and how you would stop this one making it. That paragraph matters more than the CV.
 



 We read everything that arrives with a Systems Sheet and a paragraph — properly, not skimmed. If this sounds like your seat, write to us.
 



  
 



 We don't hire roles. We build the platform. · Ownership, not employment. · Builders hire builders.
 




 Founder \& CEO, Vantrock

title: Senior Network Engineer – Cloud Platform
description:
****Position:****
 Senior Network Engineer – Cloud Platform
   

  

****Job Description:****
* Role Overview Join the Cloud Platform Engineering team responsible for designing, building, automating, securing, and operating enterprise cloud, corporate, server, and data center infrastructure. This role requires deep expertise in enterprise networking, cloud networking, hybrid connectivity, infrastructure automation, network security, observability, and production operations across AWS, GCP, OCI, corporate offices, remote sites, and data centers. Shift Timing 5:00 PM to 1:00 AM IST


**Key Responsibilities:**
 Cloud Network Engineering
   

  

* Design, manage, and optimize VPCs, Subnets, Route Tables, Internet Gateways, NAT Gateways, Transit Gateways, VPC Peering, Private Connectivity, Load Balancers, DNS, and cloud security controls.
* Establish standardized cloud networking patterns and reusable network architecture frameworks.
* Support multi\-account, multi\-region, and multi\-cloud deployments across AWS, GCP, and OCI.
* Design highly available, resilient, scalable, and secure network architectures.
* Support cloud landing zones and cloud foundation initiatives.


 Enterprise \& Corporate Networking
   

  

* Design, implement, manage, monitor, and troubleshoot enterprise LAN/WAN infrastructure.
* Manage and troubleshoot VLANs, Routing, Switching, Wireless Networks, VPNs, Firewalls, Proxies, and Network Access Controls.
* Establish secure connectivity between corporate offices, remote locations, data centers, and cloud environments.
* Monitor network availability, utilization, capacity, and performance trends.
* Drive lifecycle management, upgrades, migrations, and technology refresh projects.


 Server Infrastructure Management
   

  

* Design and manage connectivity supporting Linux, Windows, physical, virtual, and cloud\-hosted servers.
* Troubleshoot DNS, routing, firewall, certificate, server communication, storage, and application connectivity issues.
* Support provisioning, decommissioning, migration, and modernization efforts.
* Ensure secure segmentation between applications, servers, storage, and cloud environments.


 Hybrid \& Multi\-Cloud Connectivity
   

  

* Manage AWS Direct Connect, AWS Site\-to\-Site VPN, AWS Transit Gateway, GCP Cloud Interconnect, GCP Cloud VPN, OCI FastConnect, and OCI VPN.
* Design and manage secure connectivity across on\-premises, cloud, remote, and data center environments.
* Troubleshoot end\-to\-end connectivity issues across hybrid and multi\-cloud ecosystems.
* Design resilient architectures eliminating single points of failure.


 Network Architecture \& Design
   

  

* Develop architecture diagrams, design documentation, reference architectures, and operational standards.
* Design scalable IP address management, subnetting, routing, and DNS strategies.
* Establish standards for traffic flow, network segmentation, connectivity, and security.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend strategic improvements.


 Network Security
   

  

* Design and manage Security Groups, Network ACLs, Cloud Firewalls, WAFs, Firewall Policies, Network Segmentation, and Private Endpoints.
* Support TLS/SSL, Certificates, Encryption, Secure Communication, and Zero Trust initiatives.
* Monitor and investigate suspicious network activities and security events.
* Partner with Security teams to remediate vulnerabilities and strengthen compliance posture.


 Infrastructure as Code \& Automation
   

  

* Develop and maintain network infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code practices.
* Build reusable Terraform modules and standardized deployment frameworks.
* Automate provisioning, configuration validation, compliance checks, testing, and operational processes.
* Develop automation using Python, Bash, and PowerShell.
* Support CI/CD\-driven infrastructure deployment and change management.


 Network Monitoring \& Observability
   

  

* Monitor latency, throughput, packet loss, DNS performance, load balancer health, VPN health, connectivity, and utilization.
* Leverage Datadog, CloudWatch, Flow Logs, telemetry, and observability platforms.
* Create operational dashboards, alerts, and proactive monitoring frameworks.
* Analyze telemetry and logs to improve reliability and performance.


 Production Support \& Incident Management
   

  

* Provide L3 support for critical network, server, cloud, and connectivity incidents.
* Troubleshoot routing failures, DNS outages, VPN issues, firewall problems, application connectivity issues, and cloud networking incidents.
* Perform root cause analysis and drive permanent corrective actions.
* Participate in on\-call support, disaster recovery exercises, and business continuity activities.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
* 8\+ years of enterprise network engineering experience including cloud networking.
* Strong AWS networking expertise with exposure to GCP and OCI.
* Hands\-on experience with LAN/WAN, hybrid cloud, server, and data center infrastructure.
* Strong Terraform, Python, Bash, and PowerShell automation capabilities.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, documentation, and problem\-solving skills.


 Strong Understanding Of
   

  

* TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Routing, BGP, OSPF, VPN, NAT.
* Firewalls, Proxies, Load Balancing, TLS/SSL, and Network Segmentation.
* Cloud Networking Services and Enterprise Connectivity.
* Hybrid Cloud Architecture and Network Security Principles.


 Technical Skills Matrix
   

  

* Cloud Platforms: AWS, GCP, OCI
* Networking: VPC, VCN, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, FastConnect, DNS, Routing, Switching, VPN
* Security: Palo Alto, Cisco, F5, WAF, ACLs, Security Groups, TLS/SSL
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform
* Automation: Python, Bash, PowerShell
* Monitoring: Datadog, CloudWatch, Flow Logs, Telemetry
* Operating Systems: Linux, Windows Server


**Preferred Qualifications**
* AWS, OCI, GCP, Cisco, or Palo Alto certifications.
* Experience working in large\-scale enterprise and multi\-cloud environments.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation programs.
* Experience collaborating with SRE, Systems Engineering, Security, and Cloud Engineering teams.


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* Highly reliable and secure network connectivity across all environments.
* Reduced operational effort through automation and infrastructure standardization.

* Reusable network architecture patterns and Terraform modules adopted across teams.

Lead and coordinate with design, production, procurement, and product testing teams to validate cost\-optimized solutions for existing and new products under VAVE (Value Analysis and Value Engineering) initiatives. The primary responsibility is to ensure reliability, functional integrity, and certification compliance after implementing VAVE changes. This role requires validating design and component modifications through structured testing, automation programs, and compliance assessments. The candidate must ensure that all VAVE changes maintain product performance, safety, and quality standards without compromising customer requirements. Being part of a Global Engineering Function, the role demands strict adherence to defined processes and communication protocols.

* Perform testing and validation of VAVE\-related design and component changes in power supply products, modules, and systems.

* Develop and maintain automated test programs for validating VAVE modifications efficiently.
* Formulate test plans, stress conditions, and procedures for evaluating new components or design changes introduced through VAVE.
* Collaborate with design, procurement, reliability, and compliance teams to verify cost\-optimized solutions without affecting performance.
* Ensure all VAVE changes comply with UL, CE, and other international safety and certification standards.
* Prepare detailed test reports, risk analysis, and recommendations for each VAVE implementation.

* Knowledge of safety certification processes (UL, CE) preferred.
* Familiarity with VAVE methodology, cost optimization principles, and supplier component qualification.
* Proactive, analytical, and result\-oriented, with the ability to think critically and solve problems independently.

description:
**Experience:** 2–5 Years
  

**Notice Period :** 15 days Max or Immediate Joiners Only


**Communication Skills :** Mandatory excellent communication skills in English


**Employment Type:** Full\-Time
  

**Work Mode:** On\-site / Hybrid, as applicable, 24X7 rotational Shifts.
  

**Shift:** Standard business hours with occasional after\-hours/on\-call support as required


**Job Summary**

We are looking for a hands\-on **Tier 2 Windows Support Engineer** to join our Infrastructure Support team. The engineer will be responsible for day\-to\-day administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, maintenance, and support of Windows Server environments.


The role will primarily focus on **Windows Server, patching, monitoring, incident management, and operational support** .


The candidate should be comfortable independently troubleshooting common infrastructure issues and working with Tier 1, Tier 3, Network, Database, Security, and other infrastructure teams when escalation is required.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Windows Server Administration**

* Provide Tier 2 support for Windows Server environments.
* Administration and troubleshooting of Windows Server 2016/2019/2022\.
* Perform server health checks and investigate performance\-related issues.
* Troubleshoot CPU, memory, disk, service, event log, and OS\-related issues.
* Start/stop/restart Windows services as required.
* Troubleshoot server connectivity and application/service availability issues.

**Patching \& Maintenance**

* Perform Windows Server patching activities according to the approved patching schedule.
* Validate server health before and after patching.
* Troubleshoot patching failures.
* Perform post\-patching validation.
* Maintain patching records and update operational documentation.
* Support vulnerability remediation activities related to Windows servers.

**Monitoring \& Incident Management**

* Monitor Windows server infrastructure using enterprise monitoring tools.
* Investigate and resolve alerts within defined SLAs.
* Handle Tier 2 incidents and service requests.
* Perform initial troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis.
* Escalate complex or recurring issues to Tier 3 teams.
* Maintain accurate ticket updates and technical documentation.
* Participate in Problem Management and Change Management activities.

**Documentation \& Process**

* Maintain server documentation and operational procedures.
* Update Knowledge Base articles and troubleshooting guides.
* Follow ITIL\-based Incident, Request, Change, and Problem Management processes.
* Participate in operational reviews and provide status updates.
* Maintain accurate records of infrastructure changes and activities.

**Required Technical Skills**

**Must Have**

* 2–5 years of experience in Windows Server administration/support.
* Hands\-on experience with Windows Server 2016/2019/2022\.
* Good knowledge of Active Directory.
* Good understanding of Group Policy.
* Working knowledge of DNS and DHCP.
* Experience troubleshooting Windows Server issues.
* Understanding of TCP/IP and basic networking concepts.
* Experience with server patching and maintenance.
* Experience working with ITSM/ticketing tools such as ServiceNow.
Good incident troubleshooting and documentation skills.  
* 

  

**Good to Have**

* Basic PowerShell scripting.
* Knowledge of monitoring tools.
* Experience with WSUS/MECM/SCCM.
* ITIL Foundation certification.

**Candidate Profile**

We are looking for someone who:


* Has strong troubleshooting ability rather than only theoretical knowledge.
* Can independently handle common Windows Server incidents.
* Is comfortable working in a structured IT operations environment.
* Understands SLA\-based support.
* Has good written and verbal communication skills.
* Can work effectively with L1, L3, Network, Database, Security, and Application teams.
* Is willing to take ownership of incidents until resolution or appropriate escalation.
* Is comfortable working with documented processes and change controls.

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.


Relevant hands\-on experience may be considered in lieu of formal qualifications.


**Certifications**

Certifications are **preferred but not mandatory** .


Examples:


* Microsoft Windows Server / Microsoft certifications
* Azure Fundamentals
* ITIL Foundation
